articleTitle: Gesture and Voice Controlled Wheelchair
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The paper depicts the design and execution of a mobile robotic wheelchair controlled by voice and gesture using Mecanum wheels, with an ESP8266 micro controller used for further command processing. The novel system uses a gesture recognition module, which is intended to obtain commands based on hand movements to reflect into motion commands to the wheelchair. Voice command enables one to use the hands-free interface for mobility impaired individuals. The Mecanum wheel mechanism enables omnidirectional movement, which makes it easy to maneuver in tight locations and dynamic environments. The ESP8266 micro controller has been handy because it consumes less power, processes efficiently, and facilitates real-time communication. The paper demonstrates the challenges that pose gesture and voice control on an omnidirectional mobility platform and creates awareness concerning reliability, accuracy, and robustness in real-life applications. This was quite important, since the essence of this whole project is primarily contributing in two aspects: a step-forward in shared mobility solutions and being an intuitive, flexible, and efficient aid for the use of physically disabled persons.

articleTitle: Enabling Smart Cities: AI-Powered Prediction Models for Urban Traffic Optimization
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Efficient traffic flow is essential for sustainable growth, environmental health, and enhanced quality of life in contemporary urban settings. The intricacy and dynamic character of urban traffic can make traditional traffic control techniques inadequate. In order to optimize urban traffic, this study suggests an AI-powered prediction model that combines real-time data from many IoT-enabled sources, including sensors, GPS data, and mobile devices, with machine learning algorithms. The suggested model predicts traffic patterns and makes adaptive recommendations to maximize traffic flow, lessen congestion, and cut down on delays by utilizing deep learning and reinforcement learning. When compared to conventional techniques, simulations employing real-world information from many urban locations show notable reductions in traffic and travel time. The model is a great tool for smart city efforts because of its scalability and adaptability, which provide traffic authorities and city planners the capacity to make decisions in real time. This study advances the infrastructure of smart cities and applies AI to address the problems of urban transportation.

articleTitle: Smart Irrigation Systems: An Overview of Current Trends and Technologies
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Nowadays, irrigation accounts for almost 70% of global water usage. Therefore, it is essential to design irrigation systems in such a way that it can reduce water usage as well as the expense. Making eco-friendly irrigation systems is another challenge for researchers. To overcome these problems, a variety of appliances and systems combining state-of-the-art software and hardware features have been developed. Yet, research on smart irrigation systems is ongoing. To have a comprehensive understanding of the prospective and continuing instance, this study presents an overview of recent advancements in smart irrigation systems. A variety of irrigation system designs are addressed, including solar-powered, Wireless Sensor Network (WSN)-based, and Internet of Things (IoT)-based systems. The authors firmly expect that this research will significantly influence the most recent developments in smart irrigation systems.

articleTitle: Proactive Platform for Active Health Services (AHS) Considering Data Securities
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: In order to meet the high requirements of active health service (AHS) platform for data security and privacy protection, this study innovates from many aspects and proposes a new design scheme of active health service platform. The innovations of this study mainly include three aspects: (1) This study designs and develops a new health monitoring device that integrates blood pressure, blood oxygen and pulse monitoring functions from the hardware and software levels. (2) This study implements a new cloud data encryption method based on a hybrid chaotic mapping algorithm. The algorithm integrates chaotic information to improve data transmission security. (3) This study proposes a system algorithm for the multi-factor authentication and access control to further enhance data privacy protection capabilities. In terms of data security, the proposed hybrid chaotic encryption algorithm combines Logistic and Rossler mapping to achieve a balance between complexity and encryption efficiency. Experimental results show that this platform can effectively support active health management and protect data security to the greatest extent.

articleTitle: IOT Based Smart Irrigation Water Management System
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The world's most urgent problems are water scarcity and ineffective resource management brought on by population increase, climate change, and aging infrastructure. Using IoT technology, the “IoT-Based Smart Water Management System” integrates sensors and microcontrollers to monitor water levels, flow rates, and quality in real-time. Using data analytics and automation guarantees effective water distribution, leak detection, predictive maintenance, and optimize usage, minimizing waste. Precise irrigation based on soil and meteorological data is supported by essential components like the Arduino Uno and ultrasonic sensors, which allow for smooth automation and remote connectivity through mobile or web applications. This scalable system provides a strong framework for water resource conservation, encourages sustainable practices, and improves agricultural efficiency.

articleTitle: Mitigating Cybersecurity Risks in IoT: A Layered Approach to Threat Detection and Prevention
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: As the Internet of Things (IoT) grows, its complex architecture across perception, network, and application layers has introduced substantial cybersecurity risks. This paper proposes a layered approach to IoT security, examining threats at each layer and detailing customized countermeasures for robust threat detection and prevention. By adopting this structured approach, IoT systems can achieve enhanced resilience and minimize vulnerabilities across different operational domains. The rapid proliferation of Internet of Things (IoT) devices across diverse sectors has introduced unique cybersecurity challenges, as these devices are often resource-constrained and vulnerable to multi-layered cyber threats. This study proposes a layered security framework designed to mitigate IoT-specific threats across the perception, network, and application layers, addressing vulnerabilities through tailored threat detection and prevention strategies. The research methodology is purely theoretical, involving extensive literature analysis and model synthesis to develop a modular framework capable of securing IoT systems with minimal resource impact. Key components include hardware-based security and lightweight encryption at the perception layer, secure communication protocols and intrusion detection systems (IDS) at the network layer, and advanced access controls and data privacy measures at the application layer. The framework's effectiveness is theoretically validated using case studies of known IoT attacks, such as the Mirai botnet and Stuxnet, demonstrating its potential to reduce risks from various cyber threats. This layered approach provides a flexible, adaptable, and efficient solution for IoT security, offering insights into future empirical research and practical applications for enhanced cybersecurity in IoT ecosystems.

articleTitle: Rice Leaf Disease Prediction Using MobileNetV2
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Rice is a staple food hounded by diseases at its various stages of production and cultivation. It is a challenge for farmers to manually identify and fight these diseases in their early stages due to the expertise needed to classify and treat them. Image recognition systems have proved to be a breakthrough innovation for such problems. CNN, in particular, has been a prominent part of automated rice disease detection. MobileNetV2, a variant of CNN, was designed by Google in 2018 to be implemented in edge devices. The aforementioned MobileNetV2 algorithm has been utilized in this paper with the objective of enhancing efficiency and accuracy. The improvement in efficiency is achieved by reducing computational costs while maintaining competitive accuracy compared to the alternative models available. The challenge in accomplishing this is to utilize fewer parameters, data, and space while achieving high levels of accuracy. MobileNetV2 overcomes these challenges through the inverted residuals with linear bottleneck information flow, depth-wise separable convolutions, and efficient layer design. The proposed model has been implemented on the rice leaf disease dataset, with a resulting training accuracy of 98.4 percent and a validation accuracy of 95.2 percent.

articleTitle: Enhancing Crop Yield Prediction Through Hybrid CNN Models Using Multispectral Plant Leaf Data
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The global agricultural industry faces tremendous challenges due to plant diseases, which threaten food security and result in economic losses annually. The early detection and management of these diseases are crucial to mitigate their impact, but traditional approaches often fall short in terms of scalability and accuracy. In this paper, we present a novel hybrid deep learning model combining four state-of-the-art convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures: VGG-16, VGG-19, ResNet-50, and DenseNet-121. Each of these architectures contributes unique strengths to the model, enabling robust and accurate detection of plant leaf diseases. The proposed model was trained and tested using the PlantVillage dataset, a comprehensive repository of over 54,000 labeled images of diseased and healthy leaves. By integrating the features extracted from these CNNs into a hybrid framework, the model achieves higher performance metrics than standalone architectures. The results demonstrate that this hybrid approach can classify multiple disease types with an accuracy of 97.8%, showing its potential for practical applications in precision agriculture.

articleTitle: A Grading Model for Jasmine Flowers Using Deep Learning and Quantum Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The flowers of Jasmine hold immense economic importance in the agricultural sector and the perfume industry, as the value and satisfaction of the market, are heavily influenced by the quality of these flowers. The already very labor-intensive, subjective, and inefficient manual method of grading plants based on their physical and aromatic characteristics is unsuitable on a large scale. This paper handles these limitations by introducing automation in the grading process using Deep Learning and Quantum Machine Learning. The conceptual methodology mandates automatic flower placement and high-resolution imagery with a conveyor belt. The deep learning model, exactly a type of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), would explain freshness in terms of visual features like color, texture, structural strength, and vice versa. Additionally, quantum-inspired algorithms have been employed to enhance the computation and performance of the model. From the analysis, a decision-making module classifies entrant flowers into fresh and otherwise, thereby sending them to their respective places, where all packing or disposal could be achieved. This DL-QML hybrid approach points out the exemplary high accuracy, scalability, and efficiency in jasmine grading and hence minimizes manual intervention in quality control assembly lines. The findings provide the card of the feasibility of joining QML in addressing computational challenges of agro-product quality assessment, opening avenues in application far broader than floriculture.

articleTitle: Dental Disease Detection Using Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Dental disease detection using machine learning (ML) is an emerging field that leverages advanced computational techniques to improve the accuracy, efficiency, and accessibility of dental health diagnostics. Dental diseases, such as cavities (dental caries), periodontitis (gum disease), and oral cancer, are prevalent globally, affecting millions of individuals. Early detection is crucial for successful treatment and prevention of further complications, but conventional methods rely heavily on manual examination by dentists, which can be subjective, time-consuming, and dependent on the practitioner's experience. Machine learning offers a promising solution to address these limitations by providing automated, accurate, and faster diagnosis using various dental data such as color images. This project uses image classification model which is based on deep learning, which can find the dental diseases, it uses the YOLOV5 architecture which is used to classify the disease into multiple categories including cavities, gingivitis, oral ulcers, tooth discolouration and hypodontia. An interface has also been created using Streamlit which enables users to upload images which are then processed, analysed and classified accordingly

articleTitle: Interactive Sign Language Learning System-A Comprehensive Application for Sign Language Alphabet and Word Recognition
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The Interactive Sign Language Learning System is a ground breaking application designed to provide a comprehensive and interactive learning experience for sign language alphabet and word recognition. Built on advanced technologies, this system aims to bridge the gap between individuals with hearing impairments and non-sign language users, enabling effective communication and inclusion. The application offers a user-friendly interface, where learners can easily navigate through various sign language alphabets and individual words, receiving real-time visual feedback and guidance. With a vast library of sign language gestures and clear video demonstrations, learners can practice their signing skills with confidence and accuracy. The system utilizes computer vision and machine learning algorithms to recognize and interpret users' sign language gestures, providing immediate feedback to ensure proper hand movements and positioning. Additionally, the system offers interactive exercises and quizzes, allowing learners to test their knowledge and track their progress over time. The application also incorporates gaming elements, making the learning process engaging and enjoyable. Whether used by individuals wanting to learn sign language or organizations looking to enhance accessibility, this comprehensive learning system is an invaluable tool that empowers users to communicate effectively and inclusively with the deaf community.

articleTitle: Identification of Skin Conditions Using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs)
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The diagnosis and recognition of skin conditions, including both benign and malignant forms, have become a significant area of interest in medical imaging. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), a deep learning architecture, have demonstrated exceptional effectiveness in automating tasks involving images, particularly in the classification of dermatological conditions. This study examines the use of CNNs in detecting and categorizing various skin disorders, including vitiligo acne, eczema, and psoriasis, from images of skin lesions. By leveraging large-scale annotated datasets, CNN models can be trained to identify patterns and characteristics associated with specific conditions. The preprocessing of images, data augmentation, and utilizing pre-trained models plays a crucial role in enhancing the performance and generalization of the system. The application of CNNs in dermatology shows great potential for improving diagnostic accuracy and accessibility, especially in areas with limited availability of healthcare professionals. This research study provides a summary of the techniques, challenges, and possible applications of CNN-based models in the automated detection of skin conditions, emphasizing their potential to support healthcare professionals in clinical decision-making and early diagnosis.

articleTitle: Mal Class: A Deep Learning Approach for Automatic Classification of Malware Images
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: These days, malware evolves and multiplies exponentially through structural changes and camouflage using methods like encryption, obfuscation, polymorphism, and metamorphism. As deep learning has advanced, techniques like convolutional neural networks (CNN) have become powerful instruments for identifying complex patterns in this malicious software. The present study leverages CNN's capacity to detect patterns in malware datasets generated from RGB or images in greyscale and to determine the global structure of code that has been converted into an image. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) are a method of deep learning that has recently demonstrated better performance than conventional learning algorithms, particularly in applications like image categorization. Motivated by this result, a CNN-based malware sample categorisation architecture is proposed. After converting binaries of malware to monochrome images, we train a CNN to classify the images. Our method exceeds the latest advances, according to analyses done on the difficult malware classification dataset Malimg,

articleTitle: Design of a Corn Type Recognition System Using YOLOv3 Architecture
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Computational techniques are allowing a high degree of impact in many areas, one of them is agriculture, where many solutions are being presented, from precision agriculture to the use of artificial vision to analyze different aspects of plants. In this paper we developed a recognition system for the following types of corn: purple, choclo, cancha serrana, Chullpi and Gigante del Cuzco, by means of video analysis using the Yolo V3 model with reinforcement training. For the training process, a database with 100 images corresponding to the indicated types of corn was constructed, separated into two groups, a training group with 80% of the images and a test group with the remaining 20%. The results are presented based on a percentage of recognition, which was performed classifications with 85, 90, 95 and 100% probability of recognition, analyzing the results the probability value of 90% presents a greater amount of positive recognition, compared to the others, calculating a level of classifier performance at 92%. As a conclusion, we indicate the scalability of the proposal, to increase the amount of corn types, as well as to increase the number of images in the database, to cover a wider spectrum within the types of corn that exist in Peru.

articleTitle: Advancing Healthcare Diagnostics with a Hybrid AI Model
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has significantly impacted the field of healthcare by advancing medical diagnostics and decision-making processes. This paper presents a unified framework that integrates Convolutional Multi-Layer Perceptrons (Conv MLP), Convolutional Neural Networks (ConvNet), and Vision Transformers (ViTs) to address two critical tasks: sentiment analysis of medical reports and medical image recognition. By leveraging the distinct strengths of each architecture, the proposed hybrid model improves performance, effectively balancing computational efficiency, localized feature extraction, and global dependency modeling. The findings demonstrate that the model reduces task-specific errors and enhances convergence rates, achieving superior results in sentiment and image recognition tasks. This study advances the field of medical AI by overcoming the limitations of single-architecture models and establishing the feasibility of hybrid systems for robust, multi-modal applications.

articleTitle: Bitcoin Price Prediction Using Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Forecasting the price of bitcoins is significant in contemporary research, given the fact that the digital currency is relatively unpredictable and highly integrated in global securities markets. This paper compares the use of three deep learning models, namely recurrent neural networks (RNN), gated recurrent unit (GRU), and a convolutional neural network-long short-term memory (CNN-LSTM) for Bitcoin price prediction. Historical Bitcoin price data is used in the dataset, and every one of the models is trained and tested based on its performance to predict future prices based on past data. The proposed models include the RNN and GRU, which incorporate sequential dependency mappings to learn complex sequences, and the CNN-LSTM structures combine convolution layers for feature extraction and LSTM layers for sequencing. Different models' competency is discussed using the averaged Mean Squared Error (MSE) and graphs of the model's prediction against actual prices. The experimental results reveal that the proposed CNN-LSTM model has better prediction accuracy than RNN and GRU in time-series forecasting tasks, indicating that more complex architecture hybrid models might provide better forecasting performance. In analyzing and analyzing cryptocurrency price dynamics, this investigation gives information about the opportunities and challenges of these models to enhance future research.

Author Keywords: hybrid models and time series forecasting

articleTitle: Harvest Helper: AI-Driven Crop Selection Model
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: To maximize agricultural output, this study presents Harvest Helper, an AI-driven crop selection algorithm that makes use of data on market trends, soil health, and environmental variables. Traditional crop selection techniques frequently fall short of keeping up with the complexity of contemporary agriculture as the world's food need grows. The Harvest Helper model uses cutting-edge machine learning algorithms to give farmers customized crop suggestions based on real-time data, increasing yield and resource efficiency. In an extensive analysis including 600 farms in various farming zones, the model showed a 20% average output gain and a 30% decrease in water and fertilizer use. Furthermore, an 85% satisfaction rating with the model's use and performance was reported by farmers in their comments. This study demonstrates how AI has the power to revolutionize farming methods and provide a long-term answer to future food production problems. Recommendations for future study to further enhance and increase the application of the model are presented, along with limitations pertaining data quality and technology accessibility. Accurately predicting crop yields is crucial to resource management and sustainable agriculture. This study examines the effectiveness of three machine learning classifiers on a dataset comprising soil and environmental parameters: Random Forest, Decision Tree, and Logistic Regression. Based on our findings, the Random Forest model performs noticeably better than the other classifiers, suggesting that it might be a reliable tool for crop prediction.

articleTitle: Power Equipment Fault Image Recognition and Diagnosis Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The stability of power equipment is an important direction for improving the reliability of the power system, among which non-contact equipment safety monitoring is an important means. Under this theoretical background, this study proposes a method for power equipment fault image recognition and diagnosis based on convolutional neural network (CNN). First, the types of power equipment faults and their traditional detection methods were analyzed at the theoretical level, and an efficient image enhancement model was designed and improved. This model improves image quality from multiple angles by combining Retinex theory and multi-scale processing. Then, considering the importance of image features, a defect image recognition algorithm based on Harris corner feature extraction and ResNet-50 was proposed. Finally, considering that the CNN network structure is not applicable in some scenarios, it is optimized. The network structure is optimized by the hybrid channel attention mechanism and multi-scale feature fusion. In the experimental part, the effectiveness of the proposed framework is fully verified by comparing the error detection effect and image recognition accuracy in the time interval.

articleTitle: Modeling Dynamics of Short Video Dissemination in Social Media Environments Considering Data Chain
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: With the rapid development of social media, short videos have become an important carrier of the information dissemination. For example, the dissemination network analysis of short videos is an important research branch of social network analysis. Hence, modeling dynamics of short video dissemination in social media environments considering data chain is studied. The core of this study is to explore the mechanism of short video information dissemination in social media environment. On the theoretical level, this study constructed a short video dissemination chain model by analyzing the density of social networks. At the same time, it also broke through the impact of social networks on short video dissemination by combining user interaction and content dissemination behavior. In terms of video information processing, this study uses a video data compression algorithm based on H.265 and combines it with a deep learning optimization algorithm to compress and process short video dissemination data. In terms of social network construction, this study uses a heterogeneous graph attention network across social media networks. In theory, a multi-feature fusion method is proposed to optimize the network structure based on the heterogeneity and dynamics of user information on different social media platforms. At the same time, this study studied the information diffusion sequence and network topology in short video dissemination by constructing a data chain co-evolution mechanism. On this basis, a dissemination prediction model based on deep learning was proposed. The experiment verified the proposed framework from the network simulation level.

articleTitle: Hands Free Mouse Using Facial Expression for Physically Disabled People
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This research study explores the development of a Hands-Free Mouse system designed to empower physically disabled individuals through facial expression recognition. In the domain of assistive technology, where the focus is on enhancing accessibility, we delve into the novel application of facial expression recognition techniques. Commonly employed techniques in this domain include computer vision and machine learning algorithms, with diverse approaches such as deep neural networks and feature-based methods.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a vital component in the development of autonomous systems. However, several challenges, such as high computational demands, limited generalization in dynamic environments, and the need for extensive training data, hinder its effectiveness. This paper reviews recent advancements in RL techniques for UAVs and AVs, focusing on methods like Double DQN, Actor-Critic, and self-supervised learning to address these challenges. The objective is to analyze decision-making processes, reliability, and adaptability of RL models in real-world applications.

articleTitle: Chronic Disease Symptom Checker with NLP
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Chronic disease remains a critical global health challenge due to lifestyle and environmental changes, leading to increased morbidity and mortality. This paper presents an intelligent symptom checker utilizing Natural Language Processing (NLP) to assess probable chronic diseases based on user-reported symptoms. By analyzing free-text symptom descriptions, the system maps them to potential medical conditions using Named Entity Recognition (NER)and a rule-based approach. The methodology involves extensive medical data collection, pre-processing, and training of machine learning models to recognize symptom-disease patterns. The checker's backend integrates an NLP model with a user-friendly interface, providing real-time assessments of probable diseases with confidence levels. The system's accuracy is validated through preclinical tests and user studies, comparing outputs with professional diagnoses. Ethical considerations, including patient privacy and diagnostic reliability, are also addressed. With potential applications in early detection and healthcare support, this system aims to enhance disease management and reduce healthcare burdens. The key challenges include NLP accuracy, data privacy, and integration with existing healthcare systems, which are addressed through robust preprocessing, security measures, and model optimization techniques

articleTitle: Cocoscan: AI-Powered Precision Diagnostics for Coconut Leaf Disease
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Coconut cultivation is essential in tropical areas, but diseases such as Leaf Spot, Leaf Blight, Grey Leaf Spot, Root Wilt, Stem Bleeding, and Basal Stem Rot can severely harm coconut trees. To reduce the effects of these illnesses and guarantee the highest possible crop yields, early disease detection is important. Conventional detection techniques, which depend on specialist knowledge and manual examination, are labor-intensive, prone to human error, and frequently out of reach for smallholder farmers. This research presents a web-based application that automatically detects and categories diseases of coconut leaves using deep learning, most especially the Inception V3 model. The number of epochs to guarantee comprehensive training, a batch size that strikes a compromise between training speed and memory consumption, and a learning rate optimised for efficient convergence are important model parameters. In order to accommodate the architecture of the model, the image input size is set at 299×299 pixels. Through the web interface, farmers and agricultural specialists can submit photos of coconut leaves. The Inception V3 model, which has been trained on a sizable dataset of both healthy and diseased leaves, analyses the photos and offers real-time feedback, including suggestions for treatment, early disease detection, and disease identification. The user-friendly design requires no specialized knowledge, allowing farmers to quickly receive accurate diagnoses and preventive measures, improving farm management. The system also integrates Explainable AI (XAI) techniques to provide visual explanations of predictions, ensuring transparency and trust in the model's outputs.

articleTitle: AI-Driven IoT System for Water Quality Assessment and Leakage Prevention
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This project introduces some features in water management: a real-time water quality monitor and leakage detection features that work with IoT. There is inaccuracy in traditional methods which delays in detecting leaks and communication. There is also an inefficiency in resource allocation and cost management. Therefor the selected system uses sensors to gauge the critical parameters of water quality for safety and suitability for consumption, detects leaks in the network of water supply and automatically turns off the water flow in order to avoid wastage or damage. Apart from leak detection, the system gives an added dimension to environmental security by monitoring various substances present. It is also fitted with a gas detection system that has been programmed to give an alarm and shut down the water supply within an environment whenever it detects poisonous gas, in order to prevent contamination and possible risk to the environment. These can all prove to have real-time data, which would allow users to keep a watch on the quality of the water, leakage detection, and assessing safety in the environment. Using IoT technology, this system ensures that it gives the user access to remote locations using the internet. Automated critical operations, fast response times, and resource conservation make this facility well suited for residential, commercial, and industrial applications. It is always a cost-saving solution to ensure that water quality is maintained, minimum leakage is kept, and safety is maximized, thus ensuring a modern power management.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Battery Health Monitoring and Speed Control Alerts in Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: In recent days, people buy electric vehicles in surplus amounts. At times, it lacks some safety measure and it risks our lives. It also reduces the growth of EV companies. For EV battery is the heart of the vehicle so monitoring the health of it using various sensors plays an important role in increasing the life of EV and by monitoring the voltage and temperature of the battery which helps in prior detection of thermal runaway and providing speed control as alert using deep learning(LSTM) then at the same time object at the front of the vehicle like speed breaker is detected and providing speed control as a safety measure using deep learning still provide a better quality of riding for both rider and surrounding people and decrease the risk at the road. The existing solutions doesn't contain monitoring of battery and speed control based on object detection together.

articleTitle: Smart Sports Video Tracking and Safety Solutions Integrating GPS and Satellite Communications
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: As the system of intelligent sensing and video surveillance continues to improve, its application in different fields has also emerged. In this study, the smart sports video tracking and safety solutions integrating the GPS and satellite communications is discussed. The core goal of this research is to address the needs of athlete tracking and safety in complex environments. The designed system consists of three core modules, namely, efficient video tracking module, high-precision GPS tracking module and stable satellite communication module. First, the proposed video tracking module uses a Laplace operator-based deblurring algorithm for video image processing. Subsequently, the human target in the moving video is accurately tracked through the two-dimensional flow field distribution. As a global optimization, the edge similarity feature segmentation is used to achieve dynamic marker tracking. The designed GPS tracking module uses the single difference observation method to improve positioning accuracy. This module combines the direct rounding fuzzy solution to effectively solve the coordinate conversion and measurement error problems. Finally, the satellite communication module used works through the coordination of the main control machine, main controller and signal switching module. This architecture realizes efficient data transmission and processing. Through experimental verification, the effectiveness of this tracking and assurance framework can be explored.

articleTitle: Evaluating Artificial Neural Networks and Emerging Machine Learning Methods for Engine Performance and Emissions Prediction: A Review
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: These due to the shift towards the cleaner energy generation and newer and sophisticated engine technologies the prediction of the performance and emission of engine is of vital importance for the designer for the purpose of ANR as well as the emission control standards. This review also assesses the performance of ANNs and the new machine learning techniques in this area. ANNs especially the single layer and multi-layer networks have shown good levels of predictions of engine performance and emission for ethanol-gasoline, bioethanol and other fuel blends. For example, the models based on Levenberg-Marquardt optimization and the Bayesian regularization have revealed essential correlation coefficients and minimized mean squared errors. Based on comparative analyses, the further improvement of the predictive ability and speed of ANNs is stressed, including applications of ANNs integrated with other approaches like Response Surface Methodology (RSM), and other developing approaches like Extreme Learning Machines (ELM) and Support Vector Regression (SVR). However, challenges are concluded to remains including data quality, model complexities and computational resources. This review reveals that, for tackling these issues and enhancing the progress in developing efficient and sustainable engine solutions, detailed databases and refined mathematical modeling approaches are required. The directions for future research are to obtain better quality data, enhance computational time, and determine more fuel blends and engine settings for the model.

articleTitle: Method for the Management of Wireless Networks in Health Care Facilities
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Computer networks have been a great help for the scaling of new technologies, communication protocols, system architecture among other ways to develop different applications, in this paper we present a method to manage wireless networks applied to health centers, where the characteristic is the exchange of information between different systems and applications such as medical images, information of clinical results, and the use of different applications. As results we present a description of how the networks can be segmented by the type of applications, and a way to measure the bandwidth consumption by each of the networks, to evaluate their performance and to improve management, as a conclusion we present the ways how to segment the networks and how to organize to take advantage of the best performance of the network in health environments.

articleTitle: Leveraging LLM-Powered Chatbot for Learning and Optimization in Databases and Information Systems Education
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This research work proposes a LLM-powered chatbot aimed at supporting students and educators in databases and information systems in higher education. The chatbot leverages the capabilities of LLM to facilitate interactive learning, offering real-time assistance on various database-related topics, including query formulation, data modeling, and system design. The chatbot incorporates advanced pre-processing techniques such as text cleaning, tokenization, stop words removal, and stemming/lemmatization to prepare user inputs for effective analysis. Feature extraction methods such as Bag-of-Words (BOW), n-grams, and Improved Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (ITF-IDF) convert textual data into numerical forms, enhancing model understanding and accuracy. Additionally, deep learning algorithms, Hybrid Convolutional Long Short-Term Memory (HCLSTM) networks, are integrated to enhance the chatbot's ability to generate contextually relevant responses. Optimization is achieved through the Improved Artificial Bee Colony (IABC) algorithm, which fine-tunes the chatbot's parameters for superior performance. Through an interactive user interface, the chatbot provides personalized learning experiences, helping students grasp complex concepts in databases and information systems. Initial testing indicates the system's effectiveness in delivering insightful, tailored responses, making it a valuable tool for enhancing the learning process in higher education.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Cotton Fiber Collector System for Textile Industry
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Cotton dust poses a significant challenge in the cotton textile industry, particularly in spinning mills, where its airborne presence jeopardizes workers' health. Existing dust collection systems face challenges such as inefficient dust capture, high maintenance requirements, and limited sustainability. Recent techniques, including advanced filtration systems and automated dust extraction units, have aimed to address these issues but often fall short in achieving optimal performance and operational efficiency. This paper focuses on the design and implementation of an efficient cotton fiber collection system to overcome these limitations. The proposed system integrates a PIC Microcontroller to monitor collected fiber through a load cell, with data displayed on an LCD screen. Additionally, it features a fixed trolley for convenient mobility. Simulation modeling has been conducted to validate hardware results, ensuring system reliability. Key improvements in the dust collector include vacuum suction, speed control, an easy-to-clean mechanism, and the ability to reuse collected cotton fiber. These advancements not only address respiratory health concerns but also enhance sustainability and operational efficiency, providing a safer and healthier work environment for spinning mill employees.

articleTitle: A CNN and HBA Based Approach for Grape Disease Identification
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Grapes are among the most extensively cultivated fruit crops globally, with over 10,000 varieties. They serve as a significant economic resource for many nations due to their diverse applications, including wine production, fresh juice consumption, raisin production, and juice manufacturing. However, grape diseases pose a severe threat to the viticulture industry, leading to substantial financial losses and a decline in wine quality. Manual evaluation is the foundation of traditional disease detection techniques, which are error-prone in addition to saving time. This highlights the need for an automated system capable of analyzing plant health, identifying diseases, and addressing undernourishment efficiently and reliably. Accurate disease diagnosis and timely control measures are crucial for mitigating these challenges. Many scholars have studied various algorithms such as CNN, SVM, Neural Networks, Random Forests, etc., yet each has disadvantages. So we have proposed an automated deep learning-based approach that integrates the Honey Badger Algorithm (HBA) with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) for the detection of grape diseases. A phenomenal 95% accuracy rate was attained by the prototype after it was trained on a dataset of 10,000 photos. Its performance was evaluated across various grape varieties and environmental conditions, demonstrating its robustness and adaptability.

articleTitle: A Preventive Environment for Pest Over the Crops Using Simplified Network Architecture
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Crop pests can significantly impact productivity, making early detection and prevention crucial for management. Machine learning approaches are being used to forecast crop diseases using a variety of data sets. Relatively easy access to the environment data has resulted in a lot of attempts at predicting diseases and pests using this data. In this research, we provide a model that uses deep learning technique known as Simplified YOLO 3.1 architecture to examine past crop growth environment data to forecast illnesses. Utilizing large public datasets on crops such as tomato, pepper, grape, strawberry, and paprika, we show that the model is capable of accurately forecasting crop pest and disease risk. With an average accuracy of 98% and precision of 96%, it showed excellent predictive power. The anticipated results can help with post-harvest processing or insect control. It is expected that this learning framework and crop disease prediction model, which is based on environmental data, will be extensively useful for the prevention of pests and diseases in various facilities and crops.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This paper represents that one of the critical subfields of NLP, SA applies DL techniques to analyze the feelings expressed in text, image, and voice context. As new technology of Web 2.0 emerges, there are many opportunities and challenges because of the large amount of content generated from blogs, forums, social networking sites, etc. This work explores the development of DL-based SA and notes that enhancements have been made primarily on the document, sentence, phrase, as well as aspect levels. Ambiguity, sarcasm, and negation are also discussed, as well as specific domain and multimodal aspects. The work shows that it might be possible to transition to semi-supervised, and unsupervised learning to overcome real-world data limitations and offers emergent prospects in the real-time analysis, domain fine-tuning, and data enhancement. The inspiration for future research is offered by the multimodal sentiment analysis and the enhancement of the DL architectures.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm Powered Bivariate Function Encryption for Robust Data Security
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This paper introduces a new encryption technique which bases its operations on advanced bivariate mathematical functions and uses a genetic algorithm to optimize these along with random key generation techniques. This, in turn, allows for the enhancement of cryptographic complexity and better security features with fortified protection against any possible attacks. The encryption mechanism integrates random keys along with the evolved bivariate functions, and RSA protocol is employed for securing the channel of exchanging keys, ensuring confidentiality at each stage of the transmission process. The integration of these methodologies has created a two-layer security framework that combines the efficiency of symmetric encryption with the robustness of RSA. Advanced symmetric encryption combined with RSA significantly increases the security measures provided by defending against brute force attacks, cryptanalysis, and intercept threats. Through the combination of symmetric encryption and an asymmetric key exchange protocol, this strategy fully addresses the disadvantages of the typical cryptographic system. It forms an effective solution in meeting the contemporary security demands for digital communication environments.

articleTitle: 5G Technology and Impact on Modern Engineering
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: 5G technology represents a progressive leap in Wi-Fi conversation, providing unheard-of pace, connectivity, and capacity. Its deployment has profound implications for modern engineering, impacting industries such as telecommunications, healthcare, transportation, and clever towns. With speeds up to one hundred instances quicker than 4G and latency as little as 1 millisecond, 5G permits real-time facts trade, fostering improvements like independent vehicles, far-flung surgeries, and the Internet of Things (IoT). Currently, Engineers are challenged to design infrastructure that will assist the dense community of gadgets related to 5G, necessitating advancements in antenna design, power performance, and statistics security. The era also quickens the adoption of part computing, reducing reliance on centralised facts centres and ensuring quicker processing near the date supply. The transformative impact of 5G extends beyond connectivity. It reshapes the layout and capability of present-day engineering structures, emphasising adaptability, resilience, and scalability. As 5G continues to conform, its function in driving innovation and redefining engineering paradigms becomes increasingly glaring.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Hybrid Quadratic Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The Hybrid Quadratic Boost Converter designed in such a manner that its efficiency is ensured to be greatly improved and components are subjected to lesser stresses for acquiring high voltage conversion ratios, very much preferable in modern renewable energy sources like photovoltaic arrays and fuel cells and electric vehicles. Even though conventional boost converters are widely used in many applications, they are not favorable when extreme requirements are mentioned on the voltage gain because it may lead to components being over-stressed, yield increased switching losses, and also requires large passive elements like inductors and capacitors. thus, it is assumed that the current remains steady through the inductors to get minimal ripples and losses. The converter, being hybrid in nature, also enables lower voltages and current stresses across the active switching devices, thereby contributing to better reliability and low electromagnetic interference (EMI). The paper makes a comprehensive mathematical examination of the operating principles of the converter, including derivation of the voltage gain equations, inductor current behavior, and component sizing. While comparing existing topologies with this converter topology, the paper will stress on the performance benefits of the HQBC regarding efficiency, voltage gain, and component stress. An PWM-based control strategy is presented for stabilizing the operation under various load and input conditions. The simulation results of the theoretical approach for MATLABISimulink validation is shown, and it was demonstrated that the proposed HQBC has a high voltage gain with reduced losses as compared to the classical boost and quadratic boost converters. Similar results obtained from experimental laboratory prototype confirms the practicability and efficiency of proposed design. Particularly, this high-performance converter could be aptly considered in applications in renewable energy systems such as high step-up voltage gain and compact size with high efficiency.

articleTitle: AI-based Surveillance for Exam Integrity: Real-Time Detection of Abnormal Student Behavior
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The upholding of academic integrity during testing/assessment is vital and so is noticing abnormal student behaviors in examination halls in combating abuses. The assessment of this aspect tangibly most often concerns human invigilators which is conscious of human limitation and in a lot of cases subtend inefficiency, thus revealing a huge gap in research. This work intends to present a solution to this gap by creating a behavior detection system that is powered by artificial intelligence and is able to monitor in real time the activities of the examination hall and to raise alarms whenever suspicious activities are detected using the YOLOv8 model which is the latest of the object detection models. The procedure entails teaching the model with a specialized database that includes different testing environments, for example, the position of participants' heads and presence of restricted materials. The preliminary findings illustrate the remarkable capability of the model in recognizing and alarming invigilators of such activities as spies and cell-phone operators, while also allowing looking away from the screen towards other undesired directions. Assurance of fairness and credibility depends on academic integrity during tests. Conventional approaches of monitoring based on human invigilators are prone to mistakes and inefficiencies. This work suggests a YOLOv8-based artificial intelligence-based surveillance system to instantly identify aberrant student behaviour. The model is trained on a specialised dataset spanning several exam situations including head motions and illegal device use. Relevant for live monitoring, the system achieves 85.34% precision, 65.01% recall, and a mAP50 of 80.10%. Along with techniques for improving accuracy and dependability, we address issues including environmental variances, data bias, and real-time processing limits. Future research will concentrate on improving model accuracy and including other behavioral indicators.

articleTitle: Hybridization of DNA Computing and Chaotic System for Ensuring the Randomness and Integrity of Image Data
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: In this paper, the concept of DNA computing and 3-D chaotic system is implemented to maintain the security of grayscale image while transmitting through the publicly available network. Here, random selection technique for sequencing of DNA bases with secret key generated through chaotic sequence encryption technique is purposed. Generation of permutation box for diffusion of image pixels carried out on the basis of chaotic system, which create more randomness and difficult to retrieve the secret key and maintain confidentiality from the intruder. System parameter and initial values of chaotic system work as the private key. In this proposed concept, first, plain image is divided in to various block of 512 bit size and padding is necessary if the last block does not contain the block of 512 sizes and then data obtained from the blocks are XOR with the key value obtained through chaotic system. After that, results obtained from this operation are transformed in to the cipher image with using the concept of Central Dogma of Molecular Biology. Experimental result was thoroughly examined using various techniques including histogram analysis, chi-square test, information entropy assessment, differential attack and the result shows that the proposed concept is secure and maintain the randomness, confidentiality and integrity of image data.

articleTitle: Evolution of Wearable Healthcare Technology: Opportunities, Challenges and Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The rapid development and increasing popularity of wearable technologies have drawn substantial attention from firms seeking to expand into new markets and innovate in the healthcare industry. As electronic devices embedded in clothing and accessories, wearable technologies have farreaching applications, with healthcare being a very promising area. Wearable technologies allow real-time monitoring of health through intelligent sensors that send personal health information to connected devices, enabling timely medical interventions. As wearable health technologies move from personal convenience to vital community health devices, their uptake has accelerated among consumers and companies alike. This research discusses the market prospects of wearable health devices. The research considers the innovation of smartwatches and smart medical devices, investigating their technological advancements, market expansion, and prospects for the future. As consumers increasingly seek products that improve quality of life, provide real-time health information, and enable preventive care, the wearable healthcare device market offers substantial opportunities for healthcare providers and manufacturers.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithm; for Conversion Predictors of Clinically Isolated Syndrome (CIS) to Multiple Sclerosis (MS)
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The central nervous system is impacted by multiple sclerosis (MS), a chronic neurological condition that causes significant cognitive and physical deficits. Better disease management and prompt intervention depend on early and precise detection. Effective diagnosis of MS is hampered by a number of factors, such as small datasets, significant clinical presentation variability, difficult feature selection, model generalization problems, and integration of multimodal data such as magnetic resonance imaging and genetic markers. Several machine learning (ML) models are assessed in this study in order to predict the development of clinically isolated syndrome (CIS) to multiple sclerosis. Using clinical and magnetic resonance data from patients with CIS at risk of developing MS, we evaluate the effectiveness of support vector machines (SVM), K nearest neighbor (KNN), decision trees (DT), random forests (RF), logistic regression (LR), Gaussian naive Bayes (Gaussian NB) and XGBoost (XG). Evaluation is performed using performance criteria including F1 score, recall, precision, and precision. According to our research, Random Forest has the best prediction accuracy, which makes it a potentially useful tool for helping doctors diagnose and treat MS patients early. Notwithstanding these developments, issues like model interpretability and data scarcity still exist. In order to improve diagnosis precision, future research will concentrate on enhancing these models by integrating deep learning methods, genetic markers,, and more advanced imaging modalities.

articleTitle: Lung Cancer Detection: A Comparative Approach Using Regressor Methods
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Lung cancer detection is the detection of tumors or cancerous cells in lung tissue. It is done using several medical imaging modalities, such as nuclear and genetic tests, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), computed tomography (CT) scans, and X-rays. Detection of lung cancer at an early stage is very important as it increases the likelihood of successful treatment. For better diagnostic accuracy and patient outcomes, sophisticated detection methods now utilize regression models and machine learning algorithms. As one of the most common reasons for cancer fatalities globally, lung cancer highlights the urgent need for early and accurate diagnostic techniques. This research considers the use of regression-based strategies in lung cancer detection, suggesting their ability to improve diagnostic sensitivity and patient results. We created a strong predictive model that could effectively differentiate malignant nodules through sophisticated machine learning methods, such as support vector machines (SVM), decision trees, and linear regression. Regression analysis was used to assess how well benign and malignant lung lesions could be differentiated using a large clinical and medical imaging dastaset. Findings from research show that regression methods provide a sound method of enhancing early lung cancer detection, allowing for timely intervention and increased survival rates. The significance of machine learning in medical diagnosis is also illustrated through discussions on clinical implications and future research directions. The models that were tested, Random Forest had the best accuracy (94.6%), according to Stratified K-Fold cross-validation. The other models, including Gradient Boosting, Support Vector Classifier (SVC), and XGBoost, also showed high levels of accuracy, while the Multinomial Naïve Bayes model had the worst accuracy (75.7%). By reviewing clinical and imaging information and subjecting it to machine learning algorithms to identify patterns and associations, predictive models can precisely evaluate the risk of a patient developing lung cancer, leading to more effective screening and early detection.

articleTitle: Biomedical Imaging in Chest Radiography for Enhancing Physiotherapy Assessment and Treatment
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Chest diseases are an enormous global concern that pose a considerable risk to people. Chest radiography is an inexpensive method for finding and diagnosing these disorders; nevertheless, recognizing chest anomalies takes time and requires the expertise of experienced radiologists. Automatic biomedical image segmentation assists in disease detection as well as diagnosis and it could greatly benefit from deep learning advancements. What is needed is an entirely automated solution and deep learning advancements have brought groundbreaking results. Chest radiography is a central diagnostic procedure which is concerned with disease processes in the chest including the heart, lungs and skeletal structures. It is gaining popularity in physiotherapy particularly for the patients recovering from lung diseases and after surgery. This article focuses on the relationship between cardiothoracic physiotherapy and chest radiography, more specifically how it can be used in disease diagnosis, evaluation of lung mechanics, determining rehabilitation and assessing the effects of physiotherapy in such diseases.

articleTitle: A New Hybrid Assistive Module Towards Text Recognition and Speech Conversion System from Real Time Acquired Images to Visually Impaired Peoples
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Identification and classification of objects containing text is an essential step to assist the visual impaired peoples towards analyzing the acquired image through camera. In existing, familiar object recognition approaches such as VGG-16, DenseNet-121, ResNet-18 and YOLO were employed to identify and classify the object present in the acquired images with optimal speed and greater accuracy. Further those model produces less mean squared error to the captured imaged by camera. Despite of several advantages, those models are time consuming and it still produces the moderate accuracy on the dense distributions of the image captured with multiple objects and different dimension of the text present in those object. In order to tackle those challenges, an a new hybrid assistive module is designed and represented as Text Inferred Yolo model as YOLOv10. YOLOv10 has been employed to detect and select the multiple objects containing text in the image to assist the blind people with accurate text recognition using Tesseract OCR engine. Initially camera captured image or gathered image from coco dataset is partitioned into residual blocks in grid format containing equal dimensions. Partitioned image cells will be employed to the bounding box approach to extract the features of the grid. The model identifies the text features of the object and will be represented in form of text feature map using the layers of convolution neural network. Further Linear Convolution Neural Network has been incorporated to produce the text labels for the feature map containing various sizes through its fully connected layer. Linear CNN also smoothens the text edges of the class labels on processing it through normalization layer to effectively categorize characters in the extracted regions of the image. Sigmoid activation unit has used to generate the class label for the max pooled data. Finally, the segmented text is exposed to the blind people with sound using speaker and google text to speech API. Experimental analysis is carried out on proposed model composing the text detection and text recognition module explains the performance in terms of recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: Early-Stage Detection of Colorectal Cancer Using Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Early detection of colorectal cancer is important as it is one of the most common and deadliest types of cancer worldwide. This project proposes an image classification model based on deep learning architecture that could detect colorectal cancer in its preliminary stages by using an EfficientNetB0. By using the Colorectal Cancer Whole Slide Images (WSI) dataset, a classification model using the WSI dataset to classify tissue samples into six distinct categories of varying grades of cancerous growths and normal. In this model, transfer learning is included to maintain computational efficiency while enhancing accuracy. A user interface with Streamlit, which has real-time image upload, analysis, and prediction display, was also developed. The predictions come with confidence scores, and the Interface also provides educational content for each cancer stage to help raise awareness and prevent the disease. Applications with potential for medical diagnosis and as an educational tool for early detection of colorectal cancer are possible for this system.

articleTitle: Social Network Recommendation Systems: A Review on Cold-Start Problems
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The cold start problem significantly hampers the ability of social network recommendation systems to provide effective suggestions for new users, items, or communities due to a lack of initial data. This paper delves into various strategies to mitigate this challenge, highlighting collaborative filtering, which leverages existing user relationships to make recommendations; content-based methods, recommending trending content to new-comers; and hybrid approaches that blend these methods for improved accuracy. In addition, it examines advanced machine learning techniques like zero-shot learning, transfer learning, and active learning, which predict user preferences or use data from other domains to improve recommendations. The objective is to explore how these methodologies can improve the experience of onboarding on social networks, ensuring personalized and relevant suggestions from the start despite the initial absence of data.

articleTitle: An Automated Methodology for Detecting Cercospora Infestations in Eggplant using YOLOv10N
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Cercospora leaf spot, a damaging fungal disease in eggplants, threatens agricultural productivity and farmer livelihoods. This study introduces an automated system for early detection of Cercospora infestations and affected percentages using advanced image processing and the YOLOvlON algorithm. A diverse dataset of annotated eggplant leaf images highlights healthy and infected regions. Preprocessing steps, including noise reduction and feature enhancement, ensure accurate detection. Supervised data augmentation enhances the model's adaptability to real-world conditions. The proposed system achieves high precision with competitive metrics, such as mean Average Precision (mAP), precision, and recall. Its lightweight design ensures compatibility with various devices, promising accessible solutions for farmers. Future developments aim to integrate mobile platforms, advancing sustainable and scalable plant disease management in agriculture.

articleTitle: Pathology Data Mining and Biomarker Discovery with Novel Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Data mining technology has been widely used in biomedical information analysis. In view of this, this study proposed the pathology data mining and biomarker discovery algorithm based on a new algorithm. The core of this algorithm is to solve the complex characteristics and data annotation cost problems in pathology image analysis. First, this study developed a comprehensive pathology image feature extraction and analysis model, which can stably reveal the underlying feature information of the image. Subsequently, in terms of image enhancement, this study proposed a new image sharpening algorithm to enhance the feature representation of pathological images. Specifically, the model improves the edge detail representation of the image through component replacement method. In addition, to address the problem of fine-grained classification of pathological images, this study constructed a classification model that combines spatial and frequency domain features, and optimized fine-grained classification performance through a domain fusion module. The most extensive research, combined with biomarker data mining, further analyzed the key information in pathological images and provided theoretical support for the medical diagnosis and precision medicine. Experimental results show that this method is superior to traditional K-means and CNN methods in terms of feature extraction and classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Enhancing Sign Language Recognition Through LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Sign language recognition is a remarkable task in this project completed through two state-of-the-art methods, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU). This way, the system is able to quickly process each frame of the webcam with real-time information regarding face, body and posture in order to extract critical values. this research seeks to provide the necessary resources and opportunities for deaf people to be able to communicate effectively, obtain an education and enjoy their lives as much as other human beings This makes it a very important tool for education where the system can convert sign motions into text on-the-fly. The data was collected through a live camera, and key points from face, body, and pose were detected for training the model. Kindergarten used the four categories of vegetables, fruits, colors and animals. There were 40 video sequences of 40 frames with a sign in each. the model tries to fit too much to noisy points of data. However comprehensive the training, after 19 epochs the validation accuracy is an impressive 93%. The oscillations in the truth values of models are indicative of some uncertainty in learning where the accuracy is still to be settled. The graph in general shows that the LSTM based sign language movement classifier has a good capacity to learn and identify sign language movements with high precision.

articleTitle: Dynamic Color Identification Using Computer Vision: OpenCV with Pandas
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Computer vision, the cornerstone of modern artificial intelligence. Moving forward with the development of new tools and techniques, OpenCV (Open Source Computer Vision Library) coupled with pandas' powerful data management capabilities has emerged as a versatile framework for real-world image processing tasks. This paper explores the application of OpenCV and pandas for real-time color recognition and OpenCV's enhanced functionality, such as video stream processing taking advantage of Pandas with efficient data management. The proposed system captures real-time images and processes user-defined interactions to identify the color. By combining pandas, the system optimizes access to the predefined color data stored in a CSV file, allowing for seamless color matching. This OpenCV and pandas together enables the system to dynamically display color names, RGB components and hex values in real time enhancing user interaction by double clicking. The combination of these technologies represents a powerful method for solving image-based problems for innovation and efficiency. Real world applications demonstrate their capabilities.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Impact of Implementing Internet of Things (IoT) Security Systems for Achieving Sustainable Cities
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) research has helped community services undergo a revolution. IoT deployment in a smart city mainly happens with minimal human involvement. IoT devices' many uses help to improve communication, access to current systems, and range of activity execution. Moreover, the existence of numerous IoT devices has proved fit in terms of data collecting and analysis, integrity protection, and functional enhancement. IoT has networked billions of systems, which generates a lot of data analysis to improve decision-making. Considered as a continuous process, digital transformation causes changes in internal processes, therefore enabling the supply of better and more complex products and services using technology.

articleTitle: Intermittent Fault Detection and Fault-Tolerant Control Algorithm Based on Neural Network in Nonlinear Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: In the field of system engineering, nonlinear system fault detection and fault-tolerant control are important research areas, and a number of efficient algorithms have been proposed. Therefore, this study proposes a neural network-based nonlinear system inter-instance fault detection and fault-tolerant control algorithm. First, from the system design level, under the offset property of the system as a random time-delay linear system, this study completed the model definition of inter-instance faults. At the same time, a fully visible quantitative analysis was carried out. Compared with permanent faults, intermittent faults have the characteristics of random appearance time and disappearance time. Based on the proposed preliminary model, this study proposed a state observer based on a constrained neural network. This observation period can complete the fault signal estimation and system state error analysis to the greatest extent. Then, this study conducted a comprehensive analysis using the mean-sufficient model and a graph-based nonlinear system modeling method. At the same time, a dynamic system model was constructed, which allows more convenient addition of components. Through quantitative and estimation analysis, it was demonstrated that this method can effectively detect the location and extent of intermittent faults. Finally, this study uses the ticket high-throughput model to predict control and minimize the cost function algorithm for final optimization. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively improve the real-time nature of fault detection and queue uniformity of the fault-tolerant system.

articleTitle: Smart Bin System Based on IoT for Effective Food Waste Management
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Food waste is turning out to be a serious issue around the world. Our society is increasingly exposed to the exponential rise in food waste. The burden of food waste must be reduced immediately by implementing standard management procedures. Reducing food waste is crucial in the modern society. The goal of the work is to develop an intelligent food waste management system that can efficiently oversee the procedure. The proposed project is a cloud-based smart waste management system in which the bins are fitted with sensors and load cells that can send data to the cloud about the amount of waste food produced by each person. Cost is computed based on what is thrown. The weight of the food wasted is sent through an SMS to the individual's mobile phone, which will, in turn reduce food waste for them as information about how much food they are wasting will be provided.

articleTitle: IoT Security Enhancements in Smart Healthcare Using Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a distributive machine learning (ML) approach that makes use of a centralised server to assist several Internet of Things (IoT) devices in cooperatively training an ML model. IoT device local data is safeguarded since it never leaves the device in FL. Since distributed IoT devices in FL often gather their local data on their own, each device's data set may naturally constitute a unique source domain. In this research work, there will be maintaining the security enhancements for smart healthcare using federated learning. There will be securing the data of IoT -based sensors which may lose local data while using the smart systems. Removing this issue will give importance to local data also using the FL method. Thus, this research involves considering different research work and gives the research methodology for the security-enhancing process using FL in IoT enhanced smart healthcare.

articleTitle: Pixel Precision - Real Time Image Segmentation for Autonomous Cars
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This The advancement of autonomous vehicles has necessitated the development of real-time image segmentation technologies, with Pixel Precision emerging as a cutting-edge solution. This innovative system utilizes advanced algorithms to accurately identify and differentiate objects in real-time, allowing autonomous cars to navigate complex environments with enhanced safety and efficiency. By segmenting images at the pixel level, Pixel Precision enables precise detection of objects, road signs, pedestrians, and other crucial elements on the road, ensuring a comprehensive understanding of the surrounding environment.
