This high level of segmentation accuracy plays a fundamental role in improving decision-making processes for autonomous vehicles, helping them anticipate and react to dynamic scenarios effectively. Additionally, the real-time capability of Pixel Precision enhances the responsiveness of autonomous cars, contributing to smoother driving experiences and reducing the risk of accidents. Overall, Pixel Precision represents a significant step forward in the field of autonomous driving technology, promising to revolutionize the way self-driving vehicles interact with their surroundings for a safer and more reliable transportation future.

articleTitle: LiDAR-Based Elderly Fall Detection System for Indoor Environments Using Neural Network Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Fall detection systems are critical in elderly care and healthcare monitoring, but traditional camera-based solutions raise significant privacy concerns. This research presents a novel approach utilizing LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) sensors for fall detection in indoor environments, addressing privacy issues while maintaining high accuracy. We introduce LiFall, a new dataset captured using a Velodyne VLP 16 Puck LiDAR sensor, comprising 12 scenes and over 500 frames simulating various fall scenarios (including back falls, bed falls, and walking falls), contributing to the scarcity of LiDAR-based fall detection datasets. Our methodology employs two advanced deep learning architectures: Annularly Convolutional Neural Networks (ACNN) and Dynamic Graph Convolutional Neural Networks (DGCNN). Evaluating these models on both the ModelNet40 dataset and our custom LiFall dataset, results show DGCNN outperforms ACNN, achieving an accuracy of 84% on the ModelNet40 dataset with a 70:30 train-test split. On the LiFall dataset, despite challenges with dataset imbalance and achieving lower detection accuracy even after data augmentation, our approach demonstrates the potential of LiDAR-based fall detection systems. Compared to other fall detection methods, our LiDAR-based system offers significant advantages beyond privacy preservation, such as robust performance in low-light conditions and the ability to capture detailed 3D spatial information. While our current implementation is limited to laboratory settings, future work will focus on real-world deployments and further addressing dataset imbalance issues to enhance overall system performance. This research contributes to the field by providing a privacy-preserving, high-performance alternative to camera-based fall detection systems, paving the way for more acceptable monitoring solutions in sensitive indoor environments.

articleTitle: Retinal Disease Classification: Binary and Multiclass Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Retinal diseases, among which diabetic retinopathy, age-related macular degeneration, and glaucoma account for the greatest number of blindness cases worldwide, affect more than 338 million people. It is essential that early detection leads to timely intervention to preserve vision, but it is limited due to the ever-increasing demand for ophthalmic care and a shortage of specialists. Machine learning-driven systems, especially Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), have shown great promise in overcoming these challenges, achieving high accuracy in medical imaging tasks. This paper explores a unified framework for both multiclass and binary classification of retinal diseases, addressing issues like class imbalance and inter-class similarity while leveraging CNNs for robust feature extraction. Techniques like Grad-CAM also increase model interpretability, allowing clinicians to understand and trust AI-driven diagnostic processes.

articleTitle: Gradient-Weighted Adaptive Filtering: A Novel Approach for OCT Image Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Optical Coherence Tomography(OCT) non-invasive nature, high-resolution imaging capabilities, and ability to provide quantitative data make it an indispensable tool in modern ophthalmology practice. OCT has revolutionized the way ophthalmologists diagnose, monitor, and treat various eye diseases. The enhancement of Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) images is critical for accurate diagnosis and analysis in medical imaging. Recent techniques such as CNN-based enhancement, GAN-based denoising, and wavelet-based filtering have shown promising results in improving image quality. However, these methods often face significant challenges, including the loss of fine structural details, high computational costs, and susceptibility to artifacts under varying noise levels. Traditional filtering techniques, while computationally efficient, fail to balance noise suppression with the preservation of edge details. To address these challenges, this paper focuses on a propose a novel method for enhancing Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) images, termed Gradient-Weighted Adaptive Filtering for OCT Image Enhancement (GWAF). GWAF utilizes a gradient-based adaptive smoothing technique, which preserves structural features such as retinal layers while reducing noise, significant improvements in edge preservation and enhancing contrast. The method is computationally efficient and suitable for real-time OCT preprocessing in clinical applications.

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Cyber Security Proactive Threat Detection and Response Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The introduction of AI-Enhanced Cyber Threat Detection, which aids in improving organizational security through sophisticated algorithms, has caused a paradigm change in cybersecurity. The proactive posture of AI-driven detection systems that autonomously sift through massive data sets to identify patterns suggestive of cyber intrusions and attacks is explored in this research study. These tools relieve human analysts of routine tasks like threat identification and incident response, freeing them to focus on more strategic matters like making decisions and developing mitigation measures. Artificial intelligence (AI) based detection also makes monitoring network activities easier in real-time, increasing operational efficiency and decreasing dwell time. Another approach to accomplishing this in cybersecurity is combining different technologies, including threat intelligence platforms, with AI or SOAR systems. Further research and improved collaboration are needed to strengthen AI-enabled cyber threat identification in the face of obstacles like adversarial attacks and ethical concerns. Given the prevalence of modern e-crimes, this paper stresses the need for joint defence strategies and proactive cybersecurity measures to safeguard digital assets.

articleTitle: Machine Learning based Prediction of Parkinson's Diseases
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Parkinson's disease(PDs) is a neurological disorder characterized by accidental or uncontrollable movements such as shaking, rigidity, and trouble with balance and coordination. Symptoms are usually minor at first and intensify over time. PD datasets tend to be compact and inadequately diversified. Several datasets contain incorrect values or discrepancies as a result of diagnostic procedure inconsistencies. Datasets frequently have fewer PD patients than healthy individuals, resulting in biased models. SVM is a common method for PD prediction due to its ability to handle tiny, high-dimensional data sets and its robust classification skills. SVM performs effectively even with small medical datasets, unlike deep learning models, which require enormous volumes of data. SVM minimizes overfitting, particularly when working with tiny datasets, making it more dependable for use in real-world medical settings. The study employed SVM algorithms to predict Parkinson's disease. Additionally, disease data is classified and compared using SVM with different kernel parameters. The study compares the performance of four alternative SVM models Linear SVM (LSVM), Quadratic SVM (QSVM), Cubic Gaussian SVM (CGSVM), and Medium Gaussian SVM (MGSVM) using five assessment metrics: accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, precision, and F1-Score. MGSVM is the most effective model for predicting PDs, with the highest precision and consistency.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic based Temperature Control System for Boilers
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Temperature control in boilers is pivotal in manufacturing, especially in industries like paper production, where it directly influences output quality, fuel efficiency, and safety. Boilers are indispensable for generating steam crucial for processing black liquor and white liquor in the paper industry. This paper introduces an innovative approach to temperature regulation through a Fuzzy Logic Controller (FLC) system, leveraging Mamdani-type fuzzy inference system. The FLC system integrates inputs from set points and boiler feedback, employing MATLAB for data sampling and analysis. The Fuzzy Inference System (FIS) is then implemented via an Arduino-based temperature control setup. This methodology aims to optimize temperature regulation within boilers, enhancing manufacturing processes in the paper industry. By ensuring precise temperature control, the proposed system maximizes output quality, fuel utilization, and safety standards. Its adaptability and responsiveness promise significant advancements in industrial operations, with potential applications beyond the paper sector. This research presents a comprehensive framework for enhancing manufacturing efficiency through intelligent temperature control systems, addressing critical needs in modern industrial settings.

articleTitle: Keyword Error Detection and Correction on Vietnamese Product Data Using Symmetric Deletion Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Unlike normal text data that is standardized in terms of words and strict grammar, Vietnamese e-commerce product data is a special type of data created by system users, including many keywords related to brands and trademarks. In many cases, sellers aim to advertise or highlight text on e-commerce platforms, ignoring the grammar and keyword order in a text sentence. This paper proposes an effective method based on the symmetric deletion algorithm suitable for large and noisy data sets to identify misspelled keywords and recommend their original keywords. In the experiment, the proposed method is used to integrate into a system working on a real e-commerce data set, with two main functions: (1) searching for product text, to do this we use the Elastic Search tool with input text processed through the proposed method; (2) identifying misspelled keywords and giving their original keywords. The quality assessment part is done through a real labeled dataset.

articleTitle: Key Applications and Challenges of Virtual Software Simulation Technology in Data Resource Searching Schemes
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: With the continuous development of big data and complex software systems, virtual software simulation technology plays an increasingly important role in the fields of data resource search and security prevention applications. Inspired by this, this study first analyzes the basic principles of virtual software simulation technology, and proposes a new virtual simulation platform model by combining resource allocation strategy, search algorithm optimization and real-time interactivity, and conducts systematic extensibility research from the perspective of DDos detection. At the practical level, this study introduces a virtual simulation model based on the VERICUT platform to analyze the complex data search process and improve the modeling. The core methods of this research framework include the following three aspects: 1) Proposing a new collaborative management model for automated testing based on data flow; 2) Performing coverage testing of multi-dimensional data input and intermediate state parameterization at the practical level; 3) Proposing a new DDoS attack analysis and detection algorithm as an extension study. From the experimental results, it can be seen that in 50 sets of independent repeated tests, the DDos detection accuracy of the proposed algorithm is stable between 98% and 100%, with a small fluctuation rang. This shows the stability of the proposed model.

articleTitle: A Review on Advances in Sentiment Analysis: A Deep Learning Approach Using Transformer Based Models
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: A key element of natural language processing is sentiment analysis, which comprises recognizing and understanding opinions and emotions in text. Traditional sentiment categorization methods like machine learning and lexicon-based approaches were made more accurate by deep learning techniques. Transformer-based models that capture long-range relationships through self-attention methods and complicated contextual linkages in text, such as BERT, GPT, RoBERTa, and DistilBERT, have made important contributions to the field. These models perform better than previous methods for multilingual sentiment identification, aspect-based sentiment analysis, and text categorization. However, there are problems like requirement for huge datasets and expensive processing requirements persist. Recent advancements such as lightweight transformer models, multimodal frameworks, and combine efforts of transformer variants like RoBERTa and DistilBERT to improve interpretability address these problems. This study explores the use of RoBERTa-large model for sentiment analysis task using IMDb dataset library containing 50000 movie reviews classified as positive and Negative. RoBERTa-large model achieved accuracy of 96.05% on testing data which shows growing importance of transformer model in NLP applications.

articleTitle: Cluster Head Selection Algorithm using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) find extensive applications in environmental monitoring, healthcare, and smart cities. Energy efficiency, however, continues to be a significant challenge with the limited lifetime of sensor node batteries. The conventional heuristic-based cluster head (CH) selection techniques tend not to adapt dynamically to network changes, resulting in inefficient energy utilization and decreased network lifetime. This research discusses Machine Learning (ML)-oriented CH selection approaches to improve energy efficiency, network lifetime, and data fusion. Using supervised and unsupervised learning methods, ML algorithms are able to learn optimal CHs dynamically based on residual energy, network structure, and data traffic. The comparative analysis show that ML-based CH selection enhances network stability by 95% and lowers energy consumption by 50% compared to traditional methods. The research points to the promise of ML in WSN performance optimization and opens the doors to intelligent, adaptive clustering technologies.

articleTitle: Novel Urban Rail Transit Feedback Information Collection with Mini-Xception Network
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The fast advances of urban rail transit is emerging, it is then essential to combine deep learning algorithms to model and analyze relevant data. Therefore, the novel urban rail transit feedback information collection with Mini-Xception network is studied in this research. From the overall architecture level, this study conducts a comprehensive analysis of key information such as equipment maintenance, and safe operation around urban rail transit systems. From the modeling level, the Mini-Xception deep learning architecture is used to efficiently process operational feedback information. At the prediction level, this study constructs a prediction model with the spatiotemporal analysis paradigm. In order to optimize, the Spearman correlation coefficient and graph convolution network technology are combined with time-dependent graph convolution and dilated convolution methods to build the model. Secondly, the Mini-Xception network is used to innovatively improve the deep learning architecture. This improvement combines the characteristics of 3D V-Net and 2D U-Net, effectively reducing data noise while improving prediction accuracy. Then, based on the prediction results, a multi-level information fusion strategy was proposed to optimize the collection efficiency. Experimental analysis has reflected that the proposed method canpreddict the information effectively, and collect the information accurately.

articleTitle: Early Detection and Prevention of Hypoglycemic Episodes in Diabetics Using Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Individuals with diabetes, especially those using insulin or other antidiabetic medications, can experience hypoglycemia, a disease marked by abnormally low blood glucose levels. Hypoglycemia is often characterized by blood glucose levels falling below 70 mg/dL. Prompt recognition of hypoglycemia is crucial to prevent severe health problems. This study presents a Random Forest-Based Model for the early detection of hypoglycemia. The model was created with a dataset derived from Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) systems and clinical data, comprising 1,500 records. The dataset comprises essential aspects including real-time glucose measurements, insulin levels, alcohol intake, meal timing, physical activity, and demographic information. The dataset was divided into 65% for training and 35% for testing, with absent values rectified by mean substitution. The Random Forest algorithm was utilized, and its efficacy was assessed by measures including accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. The suggested model exhibited enhanced performance, exceeding that of current machine learning classifiers. The Random Forest model adeptly detects hypoglycemic episodes and addresses imbalanced data with remarkable precision and recall. Integrating alcohol use as a variable further augments the model's ability to consider lifestyle factors affecting hypoglycemia

articleTitle: Bio-Inspired Tree Seed Algorithm Enhanced Discrete Wavelet Technique for Memory Control
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The widely recognized classical image compression techniques are renowned for their excellent performance, minimal computational complexity, and the ability to generate an embedded bitstream that can be decoded at varying bit rates, resulting in progressively improved image quality as more bits are received. It requires a significant amount of computer memory as it stores the generated sets and the pixel locations in linked lists. The multiresolution feature of transform does not result in the creation of a resolution-scalable bitstream that would allow the image to be decoded at various resolutions. The enormous memory issue with the conventional methods is resolved by the Tree Seed Algorithm (TSA) an Enhanced Discrete Wavelet Transform methodology which requires just one list of fixed size with average of 2.25 bits/pixel and size of 1/4 of the image. The primary contribution of this study lies in enhancing image quality and resolution thereby optimizing memory usage. The TSA Optimized Discrete Wavelet Transform approach is recommended in this study to decrease complexity and improve processing speed. Using the unique attributes of the algorithm, it is particularly well-suited to meet the diverse skill levels and resolution preferences of contemporary Internet users.

Author Keywords: Highly Scalable Image Compression and TSA Optimized Discrete Wavelet Transform

articleTitle: Dynamic Crowd Modeling and Anomalous Behavior Prediction Using GMM and Time Series Analysis in Real-Time Smart City Environment
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The Research Concentrates on simulating and investigating dynamic crowd using Gaussian Mixture Models (GMM) and synthetic time-series data in real time smart city environments. A novel approach generates and designs various crowd behaviors, incorporating normal flow, high congestions, and erratic patterns, leveling to detect and predict anomalies that pose safety issues. Mock datasets, imitating real-world situations, are generated using spatial-temporal features such as crowd density, velocity, and movement direction. To cluster these behaviors into distinct operational states, the GMM is employed, while irregularities are recognized as outliers to the learned distributions. The simulation framework introduces temporal tendencies and real-time capabilities, aiding dynamic variance detection and proactive crowd organization. Investigational results prove the efficiency of the proposed approach in clustering behavioral states and detecting anomalies, providing a scalable and computationally efficient result for inner-city protection and resource optimization. The study implements a foundation for deploying real-time crowd monitoring systems in smart cities, addressing challenges in occasion management, transportation, and disaster awareness.

articleTitle: A Framework for Video Based Sign Language Interpretation Using Machine Learning and Statistical Methods
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The Sign Language Recognition System has been designed to capture video input, process it to detect hand gestures, and translate these gestures into readable text. The project consists of several key components and steps: Video Processing: Using OpenCV, the system captures frames from the video input. MediaPipe processes these frames to detect and track hand landmarks in real time. OpenCV capabilities allow for efficient frame extraction and basic image processing tasks such as resizing and normalization. Hand Detection and Tracking: MediaPipe pre-trained models identify and track hand movements within the video frames. The accurate detection and tracking of the hand movements are critical for the subsequent recognition of the sign language gestures. Sign Language Recognition: The core system is the deep learning model, trained using the TensorFlow and Keras on a dataset of sign language gestures. The model learns to classify the detected hand movements into corresponding sign language characters or words. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are typically used for task due to their effectiveness in image recognition tasks. Text Display: Once the system recognizes the signs, it converts them into text and displays the output. This can be done through a console output or a graphical user interface (GUI) built with Tkinter. The GUI provides a user friendly experience, allowing users to see the translated text in real-time.

articleTitle: From 5G to 6G: The Role of AI, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning in Wireless Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The swift progression of wireless communication technologies-specifically from 5G to 6G is an approach that could be the most significant revolutionary leap towards changing connectivity and data transmission forever. Additionally, algorithms of machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) in 5G and 6G can offer promising advancements toward predictive maintenance, dynamic spectrum management, and enhanced security. The review of the potentially transformative nature of these technologies underlines the need for future directions of research efforts called for in circumventing challenges towards making full capability exploitation of 6G possible.

articleTitle: Adaptive Music Streaming: Combining CNN Facial Analysis with Snowflake based Music Categorization
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This paper introduces an adaptive music streaming system that combines facial emotion analysis with dynamic music categorization to deliver a personalized and engaging auditory experience. The system uses a webcam to capture real-time facial images and applies the Haar Cascade algorithm to detect faces accurately and efficiently. Once a face is detected, the system employs a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) enhanced with a Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM). This enhancement ensures improved accuracy by focusing on the most critical features of the captured facial expressions, enabling greliable identification of emotional states such as happiness, sadness, and anger. The identified emotions are then mapped to a Snowflake-based database, which categorizes music based on emotional attributes. By matching the user's emotional state with corresponding music categories, the system retrieves and streams songs that align with their current mood. This ensures an engaging and personalized listening experience, adapting to real-time emotional changes seamlessly. This design enables seamless integration between real-time emotion recognition and music streaming, making it easily accessible to users. This innovation represents a significant step forward in emotion-responsive multimedia applications. It not only improves the interaction between users and music streaming platforms but also establishes a foundation for future developments in adaptive and emotion-aware technologies.

articleTitle: Evaluating Resizing Techniques for Lumpy Skin Diseased Animal Image using Metrics
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: In medical imaging, image preprocessing is especially significant in the analysis of lumpy skin disease in animals. These challenges are well-marked, from preserving quality during resizing across different algorithms used with those techniques in a dataset. In the paper, several recent resizing methods are discussed including fixed size, aspect ratio preservation, crop, and even more advanced methods of interpolation; these include nearest neighbor, bilinear, bicubic, and Lanczos interpolation. These interpolation techniques were applied on images of infected cattle skin in order to focus on performance-based metrics such as Structural Similarity Index (SSIM), Mean Squared Error (MSE), and Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR). The proposed objective is to evaluate whether these resizing techniques preserve the quality of the images. The results show that advanced interpolation methods, such as bicubic and Lanczos, are particularly good at achieving a high similarity with the original image. However, the analysis was limited to a single image, so validating the conclusion across a more diverse set of datasets is necessary. Future work involves combining recent resizing methods with the extension of this approach for images with other conditions, such as blur, brightness, and contrast variations, to improve the generalizability and robustness of such methods.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based Algorithm for Feature Recognition in the Construction Process of Decorative Materials
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The construction technology of the decorative materials is an essential and key research direction of modern engineering vision tasks. The process recognition and classification based on image analysis is an important research topic. Therefore, this study analyzes the feature recognition algorithm of decorative materials based on deep learning. First of all, this study designed a new image feature extraction algorithm. The algorithm uses the improved circular Hough transform combined with the Hu invariant moment to perform stable feature extraction, thereby improving the low robustness of the traditional algorithm. Then, the study used the residual attention mechanism based on deep learning to optimize the image recognition algorithm from the theoretical level. At the same time, a progressive training strategy was proposed to improve the model performance. Finally, the model combines the FFT block and the residual attention module to build an image classification algorithm. In the experimental part, by comparing with mainstream traditional methods (such as SIFT, SURF, HOG and LBP), the experiment show the proposed model has satisfactory performance in average accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Diagnosis of Gum Infection and Tooth Alignment Using Dental X-Ray
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Dental diseases, including gum infections and misaligned teeth, are prevalent worldwide and pose significant challenges to timely and accurate diagnosis. This research introduces a method using deep learning to detect gum infections and tooth alignment issues from dental X-ray images. By using advanced neural networks like MobileNetV2, InceptionV3, and VGG19, the study achieved high accuracy in identifying conditions like healthy gums, infected gums, and impacted teeth. MobileNetV2 performed the best with a test accuracy of 96.43%, followed by VGG19 at 95.72% and InceptionV3 at 93.15%. The approach includes advanced techniques to prepare and improve the data, which helps the models work better. These results show how deep learning could transform dental diagnosis by providing fast, accurate, and automated analysis of X-ray images. Future work will aim to use larger datasets and include 3D imaging for even better results.

articleTitle: Comparing Collaborative Filtering Algorithms in AI-Powered Recommendation Systems for E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The quick growth of e-commerce has brought attention to how important efficient recommendation systems are to enhancing user experience and accomplishing business objectives. This paper investigates the effectiveness of collaborative filtering algorithms in AI-powered recommendation systems, with a focus on user-based collaborative filtering (UBCF). A comprehensive method is employed to guarantee consistency across different rating scales, beginning with data normalisation to standardise user-item interaction matrices. To decrease dimensionality and maintain the most significant patterns of user-item interaction, Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is employed for feature selection. The classification system uses similarity measures and UBCF to predict user preferences based on historical data. The algorithms are evaluated on key metrics like precision, recall, and RMSE using publically available datasets. The outcomes demonstrate the impact of preprocessing and dimensionality reduction on UBCF's performance as well as its efficacy in providing customised recommendations. This research contributes to the improvement of collaborative filtering algorithms for e-commerce systems, which will raise customer satisfaction and enable scalability in dynamic online markets.

articleTitle: ML for Sustainable Solutions: Applications in Renewable Energy Optimization and Climate Change Prediction
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This paper delves into the transformative potential of ML in addressing some of the world's most pressing challenges in optimizing renewable energy and mitigating climate change. How ML algorithms work to improve efficiency within solar and wind energy systems, smart grids, and energy storage technologies is revealed by large data sets and predictive analytics. As ML improves the forecasting of energy, minimizes waste, and allows for better grid integration, its contribution to cutting carbon emissions significantly is immense. In addition, it facilitates climate adaptation by accurately predicting extreme weather occurrences and climate variability. Challenges facing the approach include data paucity, computational cost, and integration with older systems. Interdisciplinary collaboration and newer ML models tackle these challenges well. The study recognizes the significant role of machine learning in creating a sustainable environment and notes its ability to actually reconcile environmental, economic, and social objectives toward a robust and greener future.

articleTitle: AquaSense: Climate-Aware Smart Irrigation System for Water Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This research work demonstrates a smart agricultural automation and surveillance system utilizing an ESP8266 microcontroller. The system combines data for monitoring external variables such heat, light, and water in the soil with data-from OpenWeatherMaps API-for the purposes of automation of irrigation. The use of a Wi-Fi enabled web interface gives a graphical view of temperature, soil moisture, weather condition, pump status, and watering history in real time. The pump is controlled based on predefined conditions to achieve maximum water efficiency and good plant condition. This low-cost, scalable solution applies to smaller-scale irrigation hubs with highlights in automation and resource efficiency.

articleTitle: Sentiment and Tone Analysis of Reddit Posts Using Python
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The volume of user-generated content that the social media space, particularly that of Reddit, produces is unprecedented, which now can be considered an excellent source of analysis for the study of public opinion and communication trends. However, such huge unstructured text pieces also pose several problems for analytics that are exacerbated in the presence of noise in the texts, non-standard variations of language usage, sarcasm, and so forth, as well as the requirements for scalable modes of computation. Although new advances in Natural Language Processing(NLP) like BERT and RoBERTa do much better than their previous transformer-based models, at a great computational cost, there is also an enormous labeled dataset to fine-tune. Light in weight but falling flat where the situation might be ambiguous based on the context or subtlety in the expression, there are lexicon-based traditional methods like VADER and TextBlob. A Python-based system that uses advanced NLP techniques for sentiment and tone analysis of Reddit posts. The study categorizes the sentiments as positive, negative, and neutral. The tones were also kept in mind, differentiating formal posts from informal ones. The methodology undertaken was a step-by-step approach, fetching data from the Reddit API, preprocessed removal of noise, and text that is absolutely irrelevant. VADER and TextBlob have been employed to perform sentiment analysis. Developing a tone detection method depends on linguistic features such as vocabulary complexity, sentence structure, and punctuation usage. It was written with respect to computational efficiency and scalability, using Python libraries such as NumPy, NLTK, MatplotLib and spaCy. This work contributes to social media analytics through an inclusive and scalable framework for potential application in analyzing complex unstructured textual data. This maps the generalization to brand reputation management, public policy planning, and content management activities, all of which require user sentiment and tone as crucial aspects of making a correct decision.

articleTitle: Simplification Process in Supply Chain Management Through Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The aim of this study is to examine Artificial Intelligence(AI) applications in the supply Chain process. According to recent research on Supply Chain Management (SCM) in AI technology and various other technologies (machine learning, deep learning, neural network, expert vision, artificial neural network). Supply Chain Management (SCM) is transforming to artificial intelligence (AI), which improves sustainability, accuracy, and efficiency. This study explores AI in inventory management, warehouse management, customer satisfaction etc. AI Transportation, inventory control, and demand forecasting are all made easier by technologies like computer vision, robotics, and machine learning. Global sustainability goals are in line with AI, but adoption is hampered by issues like labour skill gaps, algorithmic biases, cybersecurity threats, and data quality. Training for the workforce, effective data management, and sustainable procedures are among the recommendations. AI is a key component of SCM's future since it can promote innovation, operational excellence, and sustainable development. The study contributes the objectives to analysis about AI reduced overall cost in supply chain management and also to study and analysis about AI enhanced quality and quantity of product in supply chain management. The study also discussed the SCM through the demand and supply concept economically. There are many challenges like biasness in the algorithm, skill person, and compromise with accuracy which need to be addressed. Finally, the study recommends suggestions and discusses the limitations of AI in supply chain management including sustainable future scope.

articleTitle: Redefining Platform Data Mining Paradigms with Sequential Quadratic Programming Considering Optimization Models
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Platform data mining is an important branch of data analysis. Traditional methods such as clustering have achieved satisfactory performance. To overcome the shortcomings of traditional algorithms in mathematical optimization, this study proposes a novel model based on the sequential quadratic programming algorithm. At the algorithm level, this study first analyses the characteristics of cloud platform data and its requirements for mining efficiency. At the same time, to solve these problems, this study proposed a new data analysis framework that combines sparse factor analysis and embedded database subspace detection. The designed model optimizes attribute dimension selection and dense region extraction to the greatest extent through distribution analysis and feature correlation evaluation. At the same time, the Bayesian network node expansion algorithm is used to model the association of discrete data, and then a cascade data generation method is designed based on this model. Finally, the Bayesian network parameters are optimized by the sequential quadratic programming algorithm, and the approximate value of the Hessian matrix is efficiently solved by the BFGS algorithm, thereby improving the accuracy of the data mining algorithm. The experimental part uses the cloud platform data-set as the target data-set and verifies the stability of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Energy Efficiency Optimization in the Electricity Market: A Game-Theoretic Approach to Sustainable Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Power system optimization is an important research topic in the era of energy shortage, and improving the energy efficiency of the power market can directly address this challenge. Inspired by this, this study proposes a model for improving energy efficiency in the electricity market based on game theory, and comprehensively optimizes the model based on an in-depth analysis of the game model. First, as a basic chapter, a master-slave game model involving energy operators, service providers and demand-side users in the power market is studied and constructed. This game model can systematically analyze the energy efficiency coordination algorithm in the multi-level power market. Subsequently, an improved cooperative game method is introduced to analyze the cooperative transaction mechanism between micro-grids. The profit distribution strategy is optimized from the system level, and the game algorithm is improved. Finally, an innovative design algorithm for the reward and punishment coefficients based on energy efficiency indicators was proposed, thereby promoting energy efficiency improvements of market players through electricity price incentives. Systematic experiments confirmed that compared with traditional optimization methods, the proposed algorithm improved load balancing, power dispatching cost and system energy efficiency by 15.6%, 12.3% and 18.7% respectively, reflecting the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Traffic Threshold and Potholes Detection Road Using Supervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This research study proposes a Traffic Threshold and Pothole Detection Using Supervised Learning. Detection of traffic thresholds and potholes on roads is done by employing a specific type of Artificial Neural Network called convolutional neural network (CNN). This proposed method works with training CNN on a huge dataset of labeled road images for learning visual features of traffic thresholds & potholes. Then, for detection of road hazard's locations, the learned CNN is employed by sending its information to a real-time map in order to further present on it. Several experiments are performed on images of roads under varying lighting conditions, types of road textures, and weather conditions to evaluate and analyze the overall performance of the proposed method. The result showed that the proposed approach can detect traffic thresholds and potholes with a high accuracy that can be used to renovate road safety through giving early warning to drivers. In general, the proposed method gives a practical solution for road hazards detection which can reduce accidents and improve the overall driving experience. Lastly, this model is deployed to Python. This method uses Image Processing and Segmentation classifiers. The required image can be of any resolution, and it can extract features from those images. This, therefore, increases the accuracy value to 97.7%.

articleTitle: A Review on the Applications of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Algorithms for Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Modern image recognition has experienced dramatic improvements because of Machine Learning and Deep Learning algorithms together. This study investigates CNNs and SVMs for recognition enhancement while reviewing image recognition technologies extensively through literature. This paper demonstrates how the applications of healthcare and security systems and social media analysis influence society. New developments in technology have not resolved multiple unresolved obstacles such as data bias as well as computational complexity and privacy concerns together with real-time processing restrictions. The latest image processing techniques include ViTs alongside GANs and Few-Shot Learning but developers need to achieve better results in future improvements. The main goal of this research examines present-day advancements in ML and DL with a review of their capabilities as well as constraints before recommending future study paths to overcome problems encountered today. This paper evaluates both the future potential and benefits alongside drawbacks of ML and DL models applied to image recognition.

articleTitle: Development of Summarization Tool for Novels
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Summarization tools are pivotal for closing the gap to an overbearing body of textual data; however, they generally address questions arising from simpler forms such as news articles, leaving the novel's faculties mostly untouched. Summarizing novels increases the challenges faced on the summation frontelaborate plotting twists, layered character arcs, and richness of the text. Added to that, novel descriptions require an explanation that provides a great plight and sustains the artistic content-one dimension where laid-back methodologies may often fall short. Put simply, long-format literature interlinks themes and emotions amid a coiling list of subplots, thus emphasizing how difficult it is to summarize well without falling into detail loss. This newly conceived novel summarization tool couples a BERT model with TextRank-like algorithms. It outputs contextual embeddings from BERT to pull sentences demonstrating central themes and the evolution of the plot while putting the added algorithms to work to fulfill various user requests, including hierarchical summaries. Many such outputs make the system friendly towards casual readers and researchers alike, providing a summary with an upper bend towards conciseness alongside greater detailed information. Although promising, the challenges still lie in reaching some equilibrium between narrative coherence and flexibility, especially whilst challenged by non-linear storytelling, stylistic nuance, and varying expectations of readers. Nevertheless, qualitative and quantitative analyses show the meaningful ways in which the system performs well, enabling readers and researchers to trek further toward literature while providing additional input to the much wider fields of NLP and literary analysis.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Hybrid Metaheuristic Cross-Layer Optimization Algorithm (HMCLOA) in UAV -based IoT Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Optimization in UAV based IoT networks is the most important task for the improvement of network performance, resource utilization, and overall efficiency. UAV -based IoT networks consist of decentralized architecture and dynamic topology. Due to this nature, the network faces challenges like routing, resource allocation, energy efficiency, and Quality of Service (QoS). Addressing these challenges is essential for real-time communication in smart city infrastructure, where UAVs provide reliable and efficient data transmission through free-space communication. Hence, to overcome this research issues, proposed a scheme called “Hybrid Metaheuristic Cross-Layer Optimization Algorithm (HMCLOA)” finds an energy efficient routing path for an efficient data transmission. A comparative analysis of different optimization approaches highlights their merits and suitability for various network requirements. The major challenges in UAV based IoT networks such as throughput, delay energy consumption, and QoS constraints are discussed, and compared the performance with the existing optimization techniques such as metaheuristic algorithms, cross-layered approaches, and game-theoretic strategies. Finally, it is concluded that the proposed Hybrid Metaheuristic Cross-Layer Optimization Algorithm (HMCLOA) optimization technique helps to improve routing efficiency, resource management, energy consumption, and QoS, thereby enhancing the overall performance and reliability of UAV-based IoT networks.

articleTitle: A Performance Analysis of Supervised Machine Learning Models for Thyroid Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Thyroid disease is a major causes of the main reasons for medical diagnosis and prediction is thyroid illness, whose growth is a interesting topic in medicinal study. One of our body's utmost dynamic body part is the thyroid secreter. Thyroid hormone issues are in control for adaptable metabolism. Two predominant thyroid disorders that issue thyroid hormones to controller the body's breakdown are thyrotoxicosis and hypothyroidism. Thyrotoxicosis and hypothyroidism are two mutual thyroid situations that impair the thyroid's capacity to generate thyroid hormones and regulate the build's absorption. Data cleaning actions remained utilised to kind the data simple sufficient for analytics to demonstration the likelihood of affected role having thyroid illness. Thirteen clinicopathologic features from the dataset occupied from UCI machine learning source are employed In order to prediction the reappearance of well-differentiated thyroid cancer, this article analyses and classifies thyroid disease models. Machine learning is a key component in the sickness prediction process. For complex knowledge activities, like medical diagnostic and prediction jobs, it is crucial to take a tough information base that can be combined and used as a cross model. We too optional a quantity of machine learning methods for thyroid preventative diagnosis in this work. Machine learning methods such decision trees, logistic regression, random forest, and gradient boosting remained used to evaluate the likelihood that a patient will acquire thyroid disease.

articleTitle: Analysis of Robotic Health Care Assisted Surgical Device Doctors, Hospitals and Engineers
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The combination of eye tracking and brain-computer interfaces (BCI), especially using electroencephalography (EEG), has been highly promising in neurological studies, disease diagnosis, and human-computer interaction. This review discusses the combined uses of eye tracking and EEG, their application in emotion recognition, cognitive analysis, and medical diagnostics. This research also investigates technological innovations in healthcare robotics, AI-based diagnostics, and surgical automation. The design and experimental verification of 3D-printed ergonomic surgical mask straps are discussed, highlighting the possibilities of personalized medical solutions. In addition, AI-based keratoconus detection from corneal topography imaging is examined, highlighting its significance in mitigating medical risk and expenses. A new predict-then-optimize framework is also introduced to improve hospital admission scheduling, optimizing patient care effectiveness. The study also explores robotic use in surgery, including flexible surgical tools, robotic gloves for tetraplegic individuals, and AI-based motion constraint control in surgery. Lastly, the progress in medical service robots, hospital logistics, and orthopedic surgical robotics is discussed, highlighting the increasing contribution of automation to contemporary healthcare. The results indicate that the combination of AI, robotics, and intelligent medical devices has the potential to greatly enhance diagnostic accuracy, patient care, and hospital resource utilization, leading to future innovation in precision medicine.

articleTitle: Tire Wear Assessment Using VGG16: A Computer Vision Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This paper addresses the issue of tire bursts caused by uneven pressure and wear by implementing an efficient Computer Vision-Based tire health monitoring system using VGG16 in Machine Learning. This system involves capturing tire images using a camera and processing them with a machine learning module, such as VGG 16, to obtain the tire's current state. The system can offer early warning of potential tire failures, allowing drivers to take proactive measures to prevent accidents and minimize maintenance costs. Furthermore, it can assist fleet managers in scheduling tire replacements more efficiently, resulting in improved fleet efficiency overall. The system operates in real-time, generating results almost instantly, and can be integrated with existing vehicle systems for ease of use. The proposed tire health monitoring system is an essential solution to preventing tire bursts, enhancing safety, and minimizing maintenance costs.

articleTitle: Evolving Strategies: LLMs as Game Players
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Game-theoretic strategies in cybersecurity systems rely on predefined algorithms, but they often overlook two flaws: changing rewards over time and the ability of a rational player to induce losses. This paper explores the use of large language models (LLMs) as rational players, aiming to identify adaptive strategies that evolve over time.

articleTitle: A Survey on Alzheimer's from 2D MRIs Using Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a complex and disabling brain disorder that affects millions of people globally. Accurate diagnosis is often challenging but necessary for timely treatment and care as there are no well-defined diagnostic signs for AD. Radiologists must manually analyze magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) results, which can be tedious and prone to inaccuracy, even though MRI has been used extensively in the diagnosis of AD. The automatic technique we present in this The potential of DL in enhancing the precision, effectiveness, and clinical value of AD diagnosis from 2D MRI data is highlighted in the survey's discussion of future research directions.

articleTitle: Integration and Performance Evaluation of Big Data Real-Time Stream Processing Framework in Dynamic Tracking Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Real-time data processing, especially in the field of public opinion analysis, is an important branch of computer aided stream data processing. Therefore, this study proposes a new big data real-time stream processing framework, and evaluates its performance from the application scenario level. Firstly, an integrated real-time data stream processing framework is designed. This stable device enables efficient data capture, stream reorganization, and data export at high network rates. By introducing a joint optimization algorithm, the framework optimizes the generalization ability of data cluster analysis at the bottom of the data, thus improving the overall reliability of the framework. Secondly, this study focuses on the online public opinion analysis scenario. The model constructs a dynamic public opinion tracking model based on information evolution. The model simulates the propagation process of public opinion information on the network, and uses incremental learning and deep learning algorithms to conduct comprehensive public opinion analysis and risk warning. Finally, through the experimental analysis of the public data of social platforms (such as Facebook, Weibo, Twitter), this paper verifies the application effect of the framework in real-time public opinion risk warning. By training the model to predict the emotional content, the experimental results show that the accuracy of the model is 0.95, the recall rate is 0.97, and the result is satisfactory.

articleTitle: The Power of PDF-to-Audio Summaries in Modern Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: PDF -to-audio based summarization technology is designed to enhance information accessibility and efficiency by transforming long written reports into short, audible summaries. AI, NLP, and TTS technologies that have developed recently have made it possible to extract main points without losing context. Yet, current systems have various shortcomings such as inability to process intricate PDF layouts like tables, charts, and annotations, contextual summarization inaccuracies, robotic or unhuman speech synthesis, and limited customization. Furthermore, the absence of multilingual support and easy integration into various platforms hinders wider adoption. These issues are addressed in this paper with a better approach that employs sophisticated NLP methods, context-sensitive summarization algorithms, and adaptive TTS systems. Our goal is to create a strong, user-oriented solution that provides greater summarization accuracy, personalized speech output, and improved accessibility for a variety of users, such as professionals, students, and the disabled.

articleTitle: Forecasting Traffic Air Pollution Increases from Urban Transportation Using Machine Learning in Metropolitan Cities-A Review
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Rapid urban growth and industrial expansion in Indian cities have led to a 30% increase in vehicles over the past 5–10 years, causing a rise in air pollution and health risks. Existing methods to predict air quality face challenges like limited data, inaccurate models, slow predictions, and changing environmental conditions. This review explores how machine learning, including deep learning and hybrid models, can improve pollution forecasting. It also highlights issues such as unreliable sensors, high computing costs, and difficulty in understanding model results. Finally, the study suggests future directions for better air quality management using AI-driven predictions and policy improvements.

articleTitle: A Rule-Based Machine Translation Framework for Low-Resource Language Pairs
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Translation is not just about linguistic accuracy; it requires cultural sensitivity to preserve idiomatic expressions, cultural references, and syntactic structures unique to each language. Translating from Hindi, one of India's most widely spoken languages, to Tulu, a Dravidian language with a rich cultural and oral tradition, presents specific challenges. Tulu's colloquial phrases, cultural nuances, and emotional depth often get lost in translation, as existing tools like Google Translator, Galaxy.ai, and Lang-Lation fail to provide contextually accurate or grammatically precise translations. These tools highlight the limitations of current techniques, which often lack the ability to handle low-resource language pairs effectively. This paper identifies key challenges such as handling orthographic variations, capturing contextual meaning, and adapting cultural nuances while maintaining grammatical accuracy. To address these challenges, we propose a Rule-Based Machine Translation (RBMT) system tailored specifically for Hindi-to-Tulu translation. The system focuses on linguistic fidelity, cultural adaptation, and robust handling of syntactic and morphological differences. By leveraging curated linguistic rules, a bilingual dictionary, and advanced preprocessing techniques, this research aims to bridge the linguistic gap between Hindi and Tulu while preserving their cultural essence. The findings not only demonstrate the system's ability to produce more accurate translations but also emphasize the need for customized approaches to support low-resource language pairs in machine translation.

articleTitle: Novel Abnormal Data Mining and Detection Algorithm for Intelligent Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: In intelligent systems, as the amount of data increases, how to analyse data and extract abnormal information is an important task. Based on this, in order to improve the detection efficiency and accuracy of abnormal data in intelligent systems, this study proposes a new and efficient abnormal data mining and detection algorithm. In the initial modelling process, this study introduced the minimum modification cost principle based on cross entropy for modelling. This algorithm optimizes the time series data cleaning process, thereby removing noise data while maintaining the integrity of the data sequence. Then, the extreme gradient boosting algorithm is combined with the Gaussian kernel function to achieve data dimension reduction. This operation can reduce data dimensions and feature redundancy. Finally, the overall anomaly detection operation by integrating the improved Ada boost algorithm with the sampling balance technology can improve the accuracy of the classifier while solving the problem of unbalanced data. The experimental results show that the proposed method is superior to the traditional algorithms in comprehensive indicators.

articleTitle: Secure Medical Image Transmission Using the RLCD Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: As digital platforms increasingly manage sensitive medical information, securing the transmission of medical images is essential to maintain confidentiality and data integrity. This project introduces an efficient and secure cryptographic framework specifically designed for medical image encryption using Reversible Logic Cryptography Design (RLCD). The approach incorporates Linear Feedback Shift Registers (LFSR) combined with XOR gates, enabling low-power and high-speed encryption and decryption to protect patient data without sacrificing performance. By integrating reversible logic gates, this system effectively reduces energy dissipation and prevents information loss, making it well-suited for applications where data accuracy is critical. Implemented in Verilog HDL and deployed on a Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA), this design provides a robust solution to address the unique security demands in medical imaging.

articleTitle: A System to Detect Unconscious Bias Using Virtual Patients: Understanding the Concept in Details
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Healthcare providers may not necessarily represent the diversity of patients in the US, even though more and more patients come from various backgrounds. Unconscious bias training can increase diversity, safety, and respect at work by assisting individuals in identifying, managing, and reducing their biases. In recent years, simulation-based training-like virtual patients, or VPs-has gained in popularity among medical practitioners for its ability to replicate situations, make mistakes, learn from them, reflect, receive feedback, and enhance clinical skills without compromising patient safety. Immersive technology-based simulations, however, have drawbacks, including latency and inaccurate perception of distance. This study discusses how standardized and virtual patients can elicit unconscious prejudices in medical personnel. It is the first of five research papers showing how virtual patients can better elicit unconscious prejudices in medical personnel.

articleTitle: Online Signature Verification Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Online Signature Verification (OSV) systems are crucial for secure authentication in digital environments, where handwritten signatures are electronically captured and verified. These systems use machine learning and deep learning methods to analyze unique dynamic features of a signature, such as pen pressure, speed, and stroke order, in addition to its static shape. Recent approaches leverage techniques such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and hybrid models, to analyze the unique dynamic and static features of signatures. However, there exists a problem of designing real-time systems that are responsive, and have reliable performance using the mentioned deep learning techniques because these models have to be trained each time a new user is added to the database. The objective of our experiment is to build an OSV system that integrates a CNN-based Siamese Network and a webpage created using ReactJS to allow the user to upload their signature or store it in the database. The model extracts spatial features from the signatures and makes decisions based on the similarity of the uploaded signature with the original signature of the user. The system is designed to handle real and forged signatures through continuous model training. Using a combination of signature preprocessing techniques, feature extraction, and classification models, this system aims to ensure a robust, reliable, and secure method for identity verification in online transactions and sensitive digital applications,

articleTitle: Leveraging Patient Flow Data to Reduce Hospital Readmissions: A Study Using Medical Dashboards
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Transparent reporting of patient outcomes is becoming more and more common as the inequalities in health outcomes amongst groups are being more widely acknowledged. In addition, documenting health outcomes over time across subgroups will be necessary for pay-for-equity programs like those put forth by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid. One way to visualize data in the context of healthcare is through dashboards, which may be used to identify important differences in clinical outcomes, direct focused efforts toward quality improvement, and eventually enhance health equity. We assess every study that has documented the effective creation of a disparity dashboard in this viewpoint, and we also publish the information gathered and any unexpected repercussions that have been mentioned. articleTitle: Implementing Resource-Aware Scheduling Algorithm for Improving Cost Optimization in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: An uncountable number of computational resources are shared for various applications using a transformative technology called Cloud Computing. It is an emerging technology that can offer scalable and on-demand resources. However, cost optimization and resource allocation are critical issues due to the increasing number of cloud user and their request. It can be solved by optimising resource allocation by reducing the task/user queue. It is possible only if the requested resource is free; otherwise, it must schedule the same or relevant resource. This paper demonstrates a Resource-Aware Scheduling (RAS) algorithm to increase the speed of resource allocation by mapping the user request with the resource availability. The proposed algorithm examines the log information of the resources, workload behaviour, resource availability, price, task efficiency, and reduced wastage and allocates the resources dynamically. To do that, it maps user information with resource information and schedules based on availability and priority. The simulation-based experiment is carried out in a private cloud space and demonstrates the resource allocation, utilization, response time, and cost. It is also compared with the traditional scheduling algorithm to evaluate the performance of the RAS. The evaluation found that the RAS model is more suitable for cloud resource allocation.

articleTitle: Methodology to Improve Interaction in Educational Processes Based on Virtual Reality Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Information and communication technologies are helping to improve experiences in many areas, such as engineering, simulation, education. It is in the area of education, that thanks to the help of hardware and software, are allowing to improve the educational experiences, in the present work, we resort to the use of the Virtual Reality glasses of the Oculus Gest 2 model, with the Spatial application, applied to the learning of music. We present the architecture of the solution so that it can be replicated and scaled to other courses and subjects of study, we present how to configure each of the tools as well as the alternatives that can be worked in order to optimize resources, as a result we present the advantages and disadvantages of using Virtual Reality technology and recommendations to optimize its application so that it can be replicated and scaled to other applications.

articleTitle: Real- Time Prediction of Medicinal Herb Plants using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Medicinal plants have been important in India's traditional healthcare for centuries, but identifying them can be challenging due to the many different species. This project aims to create a real-time system that recognizes medicinal herb plants using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), a type of deep learning that works well for image recognition. The system will be trained on a dataset of herb plant images, using techniques like resizing and data augmentation to improve performance. By doing this, the model will learn to spot even small differences between plant species. We will evaluate the system's effectiveness through accuracy, precision, and recall metrics to ensure reliable identification. By making it easier to identify medicinal plants, this project could help preserve traditional Indian herbal knowledge and encourage the use of these herbs in modern healthcare. In the future, the system will also incorporate real-time prediction capabilities, allowing users to identify herb plants instantly in their natural environments. Additionally, the system could be expanded to include more plant species, contributing to the protection and conservation of medicinal plant biodiversity.

articleTitle: Heat Resilience in Ceramic Heaters Longevity

abstract: Enhancing Longevity of Ceramic Heaters through Heat Resilience' explores a novel approach to improving the durability of ceramic heaters used in industrial applications. articleTitle: Revolutionizing Healthcare: The Role of AI and BigData Analytics in Disease Prevention and Management
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Big Data Analytics are greatly transforming the healthcare scenario by facilitating the early detection of diseases, personalized medicine, and improved public health interventions. AI, by employing machine learning and deep learning, processes big and complex datasets, whereas Big Data detects patterns and predicts risks, enhancing resource utilization and readiness for health emergencies. Yet, the technologies are faced with a range of challenges that include data security concerns, matters of integrating many systems, and the requirement of real-time processing in ever-changing healthcare environments. Although recent technological advancements such as sophisticated deep learning algorithms and decentralized data processing have been promising solutions to some of these challenges, issues of easy integration and privacy remain. This paper suggests an objective-oriented framework to enhance the application of AI and Big Data solutions in healthcare to overcome current limitations and establish a more efficient, personalized, and predictive healthcare system.

articleTitle: Enhanced Speech Emotion and Gender Recognition Using Hybrid CNN-LSTM Models
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The current paper proposes a new approach for peripheral speech emotion analysis and gender estimation incorporating the best machine learning architectures such as CNNs and LSTMs. Its correct depiction of emotions and the variation of the gendered speech to indicate manifold signal-to-noise ratio make the approach accommodate the difficulty inherent in recognizing emotions from the recording of voices as well as predicting the gender of a speaker. It is then able to ally with preprocessing and collection of a vast range of different speech samples, feature extraction of pitch, tone and spectral data. These features serve as input to the CNNs and LSTMs: LSTMs work well at temporal regular features and the CNNs work well in feature extraction by location (spatio feature). The approach is tested on the RAVDESS and IEMOCAP datasets and establishes a near perfect match to prior approaches with reference to recognition accuracy of emotion analysis and gender prediction. Thus, applying the identified dual method approach, which could be described by such characteristics as highly accurate data pre-preprocessing, clear indication of the features of interest, a different CNN-LSTM model joint training, it offers a reasonably good platform to gain certain insights into such characteristics of the speech as our experiment demonstrates. This work offers satisfactory configurations on concerns such as human computer relation, customer relation and mental health surveillance to suggest that other applications could be achieved in future.

articleTitle: Smart Barcode Scanning using X-ray Technology with Computer Vision and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Barcode scanning errors in retail environments contribute to inventory discrepancies, financial losses, and inefficiencies in stock management. Traditional optical barcode scanning methods are prone to failures due to occlusion, poor lighting conditions, and barcode damage. While recent advancements such as computer vision, deep learning-based error detection, and RFID integration have improved scanning accuracy, these approaches still face challenges related to high computational requirements, environmental dependencies, and implementation costs. This paper proposes a novel method utilizing X-ray imaging technology and advanced machine learning algorithms to detect improperly scanned or missing barcodes in real time. The system captures detailed X-ray images of items as they enter retail stores or warehouses and applies deep learning models to analyze barcode visibility. Real-time alerts are generated when scanning anomalies are detected, enabling prompt corrective action. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that the proposed approach significantly improves barcode detection accuracy, enhances inventory management, and reduces operational costs. The findings highlight the potential for widespread deployment in retail and logistics environments, offering a robust solution to barcode scanning challenges.

articleTitle: A Novel Emotion Recognition System Based on Non-Invasive EEG Signals
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Emotion recognition is an important scenario for EEG applications, which can assist in the stable analysis of EEG information. In this study, the novel emotion recognition system based on non-invasive EEG signals is proposed. In the signal acquisition and the processing stage, this study adopted a standardized EEG signal acquisition process, combined with artifact space reconstruction technology to remove signal noise, laying the foundation for accurate analysis process. In the EEG data feature extraction stage, this study effectively captures the randomness and complexity characteristics of the EEG signals through an algorithm that combines differential entropy and power spectral density. Subsequently, at the emotion recognition level, this study designed and trained a deep neural network model, including four convolutional layers, four maximum pooling layers and a fully connected layer, to extract multi-level features and complete the emotion data classification. The experiment was verified on a self-collected EEG dataset, and 10 groups of comparative tests were conducted on the Accuracy and Precision indicators, with the traditional algorithm as the comparison object. The results show that the system has good performance in emotion recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: Multi Class Spectral Discriminative Convolutional Neural Network Towards Hyperspectral Image Classification of Crop Disease on Inclusion of Spectral Spatial Feature Fusion Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Crop diseases occurs due to bacterial, viral, parasitic and fungal infection leads to various challenges to farmer and agricultural based business as crop diseases effects the normal growth of the crop and it spreads to other crops surrounding it. Especially those crop infection leads to great economic damage to the farmers and to the entire country. In order to prevent, classify and mitigate those crop infections, effective measures have to be carried out. Manual observation by biologist and agriculturist leads to misinterpretation and time consuming. In particular, remote sensing technologies using hyperspectral imaging techniques helps to monitor and acquire the agriculture information in various target regions effectively. Due to development of computer vision technique and artificial intelligence approaches in form of machine learning and deep learning architectures, countermeasure against the crop disease can be achieved easily on processing the acquired information in form of hyperspectral images. However traditional architecture faces multiple challenges in form of the spectral signatures unmixing as boundaries of the objects of different diseases types is very complex to be filtered. Thus, a new spectral unmixing based object recognition method has to be constructed to categorizes different form of crop disease in the agriculture region. In this paper, Multi Class Spectral Discriminative Convolution Neural Network(MCSD-CNNN) using spectral and spatial feature fusion towards hyperspectral image classification for detect, classify and mitigate the crop diseases on various climate and various regions. Initially image preprocessing is carried out to eliminate the spectral noises. Preprocessed image is projected to convolution layer of the network to extract the endmembers of the spectral band representing the various crop species in the different climate and spatial regions. Extracted end member of the spectral band is represented spectral disease index map. Those spectral index map is processed in the pooling layer for spatial correction and compute extreme spectral variability through incorporation of attention mechanism with attention coefficient to discriminate spectral endmembers effectively. Discriminated Spectral Member is organized as spectral map. Fully connected layer containing the softmax layer employs the classifier to process the spectral map of the specific crop species on the various climates on multiple region with respect to Chlorophyll and Nitrogen spectral values of the end members to detect the disease and classify the disease on basis of the spectral signature which represents the severity of crop.
