abstract: The advancement of technologies pays the way for plenty of information to be from online. Researchers are presently inspecting advanced techniques that develop deep learning models, comprising Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT), to overcome this problem. However, because of the limitations caused by the length of the document, BERT is not able to amply condense large documents. This research suggests a novel procedure to address the complications by adding a grouping of methods of pre-processing technique, Feature Extraction (FE), and classification. In FE, the focus is to extract the important features using a Cluster-Based System (CBS) and balance the dataset and word representation. Finally, the BERT is pre-trained on enormous datasets and is then united with the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). Experimental exploration is carried out using datasets from arXiv and YouTube revealing that the proposed method implemented better than several representations. The arrangement of LSTM with BERT has been given outcomes in a noteworthy enhancement in the text summarisation. In addition to being favourable to a variety of fields that demand summaries that are precise and informative, this research establishes opportunities for summarising long transcripts to give valid points from the keywords.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Smart Grid Energy Management Using the Osprey Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Smart Grid Energy Management (SGEM) denotes the function of optimizing energy flow in the grid while enhancing grid efficiency and stability. One major issue is that increased integration of Renewable Energy Sources (RESs) may add a layer of complexity to EM, which may, in turn, reduce the reliability and stability of the grid. Keeping such challenges in mind, this paper proposes the Osprey Optimization Algorithm (OOA) on its part to enhance SGEM through various facets of load balancing and energy distribution. The objective of this method is to minimize the Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE), enhancing the precision of energy predictions and optimizing grid performance. The OOA optimizes energy distribution in micro grids, improving efficiency and reducing power losses. The performance of the suggested OOA method is assessed by contrasting it with other optimization approaches that are currently in use, including Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Multi Objective Genetic Algorithm (MOGA), Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA), and Multi Objective Wind Driven Optimization (MOWDO). The OOA method is implemented on the MATLAB platform. The outcomes show that the proposed OOA method provides superior performance in minimizing MAPE, achieving the lowest MAPE value of 0.28%, indicating its enhanced accuracy in energy demand forecasting and optimization.

articleTitle: Customized Graph-Cut Segmentation with Superpixels for Snowfall Detection on Solar Panels
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Snow accumulation on solar panels reduces their performance in energy generation regions. Hence certain image processing methods were developed for segmenting snow from the normal areas of solar panels. Graph Cut and Flood Fill are the popular semi-automatic method used for this application where it relies on detecting an efficient region for marking the segmentation process. Similarly, the manual intervention fails to provide consistent results in such methods. Therefore, a customized graph cut methodology is proposed in this work by combining super pixel-based feature extraction and k-means clustering. At first, the input images are preprocessed by dividing the pixels to form super pixels as a group to reduce the computational complexity without losing the meaningful information. Features like intensity, edge density, texture, and color are extracted from these super pixel groups for segmenting the snow-covered regions on a solar panel. Further, the extracted features are normalized by a k-means clustering algorithm for identifying the highest intensity regions to observe the snow-covered regions. A graph cut-based segmentation technique is applied at the end to ensure the precise boundary delineation. The work is also incorporated with several post-processing techniques for improving the segmentation mask quality. This proposed method is evaluated against Graph cut and flood fill and satisfied with an average dice similarity coefficient of 93.09% and 95.11%.

articleTitle: CNN-LSTM based Approach for Detection of Early Violence in Campus Environment
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Campus violence is a critical social issue affecting educational institutions around the world. The extremely high frequency not only affects the actual learning process but leads to anxiety and adversely affects both students and staff. This paper introduces a hybrid deep learning model that combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks to detect four categories of violence-slapping, kicking, punching, and group violence. The CNN component extracts spatial features, while the LSTM captures temporal patterns, enabling accurate recognition of violent behaviors. Additionally, the paper includes a face detection and identification module that activates when violent behavior is detected. By using ArcFace model, the system matches faces with a database containing details like names and roll numbers, making sure the action is thorough and quick. The system, trained on different datasets simulating real-world campus scenarios, identified high accuracy, precision, and recall in identifying violent actions.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Driver Drowsiness Detection in Real Time Environment - An Enhanced Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Effective driver behavior monitoring is necessary due to the increase in traffic accidents caused by distracted driving. In order to identify distractions such as talking, drinking, napping, and using a phone, this research suggests a CNN-based methodology. The model uses facial characteristics such as eyes to detect and analyze these activities. Thousands of photos depicting various distracted driving postures are used to train it on a publicly accessible dataset. The strategy seeks to improve road safety by offering a reliable way to identify distractions.

articleTitle: A Review Analysis on Smart Blind Stick Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Millions of individuals worldwide struggle with blindness and other forms of visual impairment. 940 million individuals will suffer some degree of vision loss by 2015, according to the WHO (World Health Organization). 246 million people experience fleeting apparitions, while 39 million people are blind. Most people with bad vision are older than 50 and live in industrialized cultures. The main challenge that blind individuals encounter is mobility. They are cut off from their environment. Since they are oblivious to what is going on around them, they require assistance. Technological advancements have been crucial in increasing the mobility and freedom of those who are blind. One such innovation is the Smart Blind Stick, a high-tech assistance gadget made to improve the safety and navigation of the blind. The goal of this review article is to examine the many facets of Smart Blind Stick technology, including its functionality, benefits, drawbacks, and overall influence on users' life. This review aims to shed light on the current status of Smart Blind Stick technology and its potential future advances by reviewing existing literature and advancements.

articleTitle: CODE-MNET: Coconut Leaf Disease Classification Using Deep Learning Based MobileNet
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Coconut is considered a “functional food” because of its rich nutritional content, which includes healthy fats, vitamins, and minerals. It provides essential nutrients such as fiber, potassium, and magnesium that contribute to overall health. Coconut leaf disease (CLD) poses a significant threat to coconut production worldwide, requiring efficient and accurate detection methods. To overcome these challenges, a novel deep learning-based CODE-MNET model has been proposed for classifying the CLD. Initially, the dataset was gathered from coconut farms in the Chennai region of Tamil Nadu and the collected image of a coconut leaf is taken as a test image to analyse whether it is healthy or diseased. The gathered images are pre-processed using a gaussian filter for eliminating the noise artifacts and adjusting the image size to make it uniform for analysis. To increase the diversity of training data by utilizing random transformations such as rotating, flipping to generate additional variations of the original image. An important color feature can be extracted from the pre-processed image by using MobileNet. Then, the extracted features are fed into various machine learning (ML) algorithms such as support vector machine (SVM), random forest (RF), decision tree (DT) and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) to classify the image as either healthy or diseased. The classification accuracy of 98.81% for the proposed SVM is highly reliable for publicly available dataset. The proposed CODE-MNET model achieves the overall accuracy by 5.15%, 19.03% and 16.95% compared to the existing methods such as CNN, YOLOv9 and Federated learning.

articleTitle: Development of Fast Prediction System of User Action for a Fully Autonomous Smart Home System
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The HVAC system, energy storage building, distributed power supply, and other equipment are integrated into the scheduling algorithm, which is aimed at reducing household electricity consumption. It is also assumed that users can provide energy to the grid according to their own conditions. Taking electricity cost and comfort level as optimization targets, a home energy optimization control model for the coordinated management of hybrid energy sources is built. A smart scheduling mechanism based on the improved adaptive particle swarm optimization approach is proposed in order to derive the best time intervals for electric appliances, necessary power for the control of the room temperature for every time frame, and power for charging and discharging of the storage battery at various moments. Simulation results show that through the incorporation of distributed photovoltaic power generation, backup storage by battery, and home energy optimization control, the system efficiently balances between user comfort and electricity consumption. This offers great technical support to the development of home energy management systems. By using time-of-use electricity price for energy acquisition and supply, the optimization control goal is minimizing both power use and cost as well as preserving comfort levels. The hybrid energy management's proposed home energy optimization control model uses an adaptive particle swarm optimization algorithm to find the optimal operation schedules of the electrical appliances, the required power for temperature control in a room, and the charge/discharge power level of the storage battery at each time interval. As per the optimization principle, the proposed dynamic programming algorithm converts the multi-stage problem into a sequence of single-stage problems and solves them separately. This method successfully resolves intricate problems that cannot be addressed through greedy algorithms or divide-and-conquer. In this research, management accounting, operations research, and financial modeling challenges were taken into consideration, and a normalization research method was used. Additionally, integrating data mining and strategic management accounting, the usage of dynamic programming algorithms in management accounting was researched. The conclusions show that the dynamic programming algorithm is of importance in competitive business markets and enterprise crisis prediction. Lastly, the competitive situation of accounting firms was evaluated using the dynamic programming algorithm, and a decision-making model for enterprise crisis warning systems was established.

articleTitle: Building Scalable Airlines Reservation Systems: A Microservices Approach Using AI and Deep Learning for Enhanced User Experience
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This study investigates the design and implementation of a scalable airline reservation system through a microservice architecture with AI-based personalization and real-time updates. This architecture, on the other hand, breaks the various core functionalities into independent services so as to deliver a statement of flexibility, scalability, and fault tolerance. This system uses ASP.NET as its front end for providing dynamic and user-friendly interfaces for applications while SQL Server will act as the back-end database to store data reliably and manage it effectively. Personalization and optimizations like flight recommendations and fraud detections are made using AI-based frameworks like TensorFlow and PyTorch. The real-time airlines databases and APIs keep flight updates accurate and fresh for the users. A case study prototype simulation where immediate user experience through notifications and personalized flight recommendations can be judged based on the performance of the proposed system pertaining to load handling, latency, and fault-tolerance simulation as compared to traditional reservation systems demonstrates such performance. The former win will subsequently reveal superior scalability, with better optimized response times and resilience at peak times of traffic durability. Also, instantaneous notifications and personalized flight recommendations improve user satisfaction through deep learning models. It can thus be concluded that this system improves significantly in scalability, efficiency, and user engagement by providing very solid and future-proof solutions for modern airline reservations. On one hand by microservices usage and AI, the system provides a pretty much efficient, fault-tolerant, and scalable replacement over conventional reservation frameworks.

articleTitle: A Review on the Applications of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques for Skin Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Skin cancer is the most commonly reported type of cancer globally and one of the few cancers that can be effectively treated if detected in its early stages. Recent advancements in artificial intelligence (AI) have significantly improved skin cancer diagnosis through Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) models. This review explores ML and DL methodologies, including Random Forest, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Inception Networks, ResNets, and Support Vector Machines (SVMs), which have been widely used for automated diagnosis. However, existing AI-based systems face several challenges, including the need for balanced datasets, model interpretability issues, computational complexity, and difficulties in generalizing across diverse populations. Moreover, multimodal detection systems and Explainable AI (XAI) present additional challenges in making AI-driven diagnoses more reliable and transparent. This article discusses these challenges while also highlighting emerging techniques that integrate multiple data sources and individualized diagnostic tools to enhance precision. By addressing these challenges, this review aims to provide insights into the practical advancements and future directions of AI in skin cancer detection and treatment.

articleTitle: Towards Early Stroke Prediction: Detecting Hidden Patterns with Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Soft computing has found wide-ranging applications in diverse fields, including agriculture, finance, commerce, retail, education, healthcare, genetics, and genomics. Among these areas, healthcare is a critical domain that soft computing techniques can profoundly impact. The adoption of machine learning methods in the healthcare industry has steadily increased due to their potential to improve decision-making and uncover valuable patterns. The healthcare sector presents an ideal platform for implementing soft computing techniques, given the massive amounts of data generated daily in health records. Machine learning has demonstrated remarkable effectiveness in manually identifying hidden patterns that are difficult to discern. This capability of machine learning can lead to significant improvements in diagnosis, the development of innovative treatments, cost reduction, and enhanced patient care, making it a compelling choice for integration in the healthcare industry-diseases like heart disease, stroke, lung cancer, and diabetes demand intensive research and investigation. Brain stroke stands out as a severe and potentially fatal condition arising from interrupted blood supply to a portion of the brain. The lack of oxygen and glucose supply leads to the deterioration and eventual death of brain cells. As the second most common disease worldwide, early diagnosis and prediction become paramount for the survival of patients suffering from brain strokes. This research paper delves into utilizing machine learning techniques for early illness identification, primarily focusing on predicting the likelihood of strokes before they occur. The stroke probability dataset, encompassing input variables such as gender, the number of diseases, age, and smoking habits, was sourced from the kaggle database. Various machine learning algorithms were employed to construct prediction models, including Random Forest, KNN, Logistic Regression, SVM, and Decision Trees. Through this work, the author provides valuable insights into brain stroke-related studies and lays the groundwork for future advancements in healthcare interventions that leverage machine learning techniques. A major challenge in this work is achieving high precision and reliability in stroke prediction models due to the complication and variety of medical data. Additionally, addressing data imbalance and refining machine learning algorithms for practical clinical use pose noteworthy difficulties

articleTitle: Security Alert Initiative for Violence Undertaking – A Violence Detection System in College Environment
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Automated video surveillance systems are important for spotting violence, like fights, to keep places safe. Considering a college environment it needs a lot of security personnel to check on the footage constantly and to react. This results in higher costs in terms of both time and finances. Implementing automated violence detection in surveillance cameras within a college setting is essential to address these challenges. Violent behavior is identified through the analysis of camera footage, allowing for prompt alerts to be sent to officials for immediate action. Previous research has largely relied on handcrafted features or traditional learning models to detect violence, but these methods often struggle with diverse video formats. The current systems encounter issues such as frequent false alerts and significant computational demands when monitoring and analyzing videos in real time. This paper proposes a novel approach to violence detection using ConvLSTM, a deep learning model that combines the spatial feature extraction capabilities of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) with the temporal modeling strengths of Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. By fusing CNN and LSTM, ConvLSTM achieves state-of-the-art performance, with an accuracy of 91% and a Macro Average F1-Score of 90%. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of ConvLSTM in detecting violent behavior, with precision and recall rates of 95% and 91%, respectively, for violent behavior classification.

articleTitle: Solving IT Challenges with Digital Twins: A Simplified Approach for Enhanced Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This research study examines how Digital Twins affect key performance metrics in the operational framework of a business. The organization had fifteen hours of monthly downtime on average before to the introduction of Digital Twins; this improved to only three hours afterward, demonstrating better system uptime. A significant decrease in issue resolution time indicates better proactive problem-solving. Routine operating chores were reduced from eight to four hours per week, indicating a greater allocation of resources and an improvement in operational workflow efficiency. The number of cybersecurity incidents decreased from two each quarter to 0.5, indicating the value of Digital Twins in strengthening security measures. The optimization of resource use rose from 70% to 90%, demonstrating enhanced cost-effectiveness. A percentage of satisfied users increased from 65% to 85%, highlighting the benefits for IT professionals. The degree of comfort that IT staff had using new technologies rose from 40% to 80%, demonstrating competency enhancement, demonstrating the efficacy of training programs. In summary, the study demonstrates how Digital Twins may significantly improve cybersecurity, productivity, user satisfaction, and IT proficiency.

articleTitle: Automated Parking System Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Among the most significant problems with urban transportation is traffic congestion, which leads to wasteful usage of air energy and produces pollution. The lack of parking places falls into the first rank of causes of traffic congestion. Urbanization in massive amounts, due to the frequent migration of populations worldwide from rural areas to cities, is making big cities more densely populated than ever. In order to fulfill the expectations regarding smart cities, the urban infrastructure worldwide had to advance technologically. The notion of conceptualizing a Smart City has been now turn into a reality with the rise of IOT. The Smart Parking System (SPS) has transformed due to the Internet of Things. and so many other aspects of life. parking is becoming a very vital necessity in our daily lives. Managing large free parking areas is a problem in developing countries like India. The Traditional Parking Management System by Other communication modules and sensors don't serve purpose of closed as well as open parking space solutions. This work uses the technology of a smartphone application with an infrared sensor, which locates open parking areas to reduce the traffic congestion.

articleTitle: Development of LPPT based High Gain Configurations of Modified SEPIC Converters for Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: In current renewable energy systems, effective power conversion is critical for making the most of the energy supplied by solar panels. This research introduces a new high-gain Modified Single-Ended Primary Inductor Converter (SEPIC) configuration that is specifically tailored for use with electric car batteries. The suggested system includes an ultracapacitor for energy storage stabilisation, a solar photovoltaic (PV) panel as the major source of energy, & a Low Power Point Tracking (LPPT) algorithm managed by a PIC16F887 microcontroller. The system's goal is to ensure a stable and effective power transfer from the photovoltaic cells to the load while also charging the batteries. With the addition of a Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) approach, the redesigned SEPIC converter is fine-tuned for excellent efficiency and steady output voltage. This arrangement provides an improved electrical conversion solution for renewable energy-based systems, especially in electric vehicle applications where high gain and dependable performance are required.

articleTitle: Early Detection of Chronic Diseases Using Machine and Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Today's persons suffer from a wide variety of diseases due to various influences and choices made at the community level. Thus, to prevent the occurrence of such illnesses persistent identification and prediction are paramount. Manually determining the disorders is generally challenging for the doctors to be accurate with the exact numbers. The objective of this study is thus to use these chronic conditions and an accompanying test to select people who will be predominantly affected by these diseases. This might be done by making certain that this categorization correctly singles out people with chronic diseases employing the most advanced data learning technique. Another tough issue is a prediction concerning health conditions. It can therefore be concluded that data mining is an important component of sickness prediction. Employing automatic feature extraction and disease prediction by CNN, distance computation employing KNN for identification of the closest match or data within the data set, and the last disease prognosis of a broad disease, the proposed system enables the determination of patient's symptoms. The patient's life history, medical history of consultations, and illness symptoms were used to construct the data client set. It is on this comprehensive sickness prediction that all of these details were considered. The above said method is compared with logistic regression, Decision tree and Naive Bayes in the conclusion part of the paper.

articleTitle: Decoding Public Opinions on Nusantara (IKN): Sentiment Analysis of Social Media Reactions to Nusantara Development Using Logistic Regression and XGBoost
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The significance of understanding public opinion on policy decisions is highlighted, particularly in the context of Nusantara. This study examines public sentiment toward relocating Indonesia's capital to Nusantara (IKN) using Logistic Regression and XGBoost. TF-IDF was used for text representation, while SMOTE was applied to handle data imbalance. The results show that Logistic Regression performs well for neutral and positive sentiments, while XGBoost excels in identifying negative sentiment, with Logistic Regression's accuracy of 66% and XGBoost's accuracy of 70%. The discussion focuses on how XGBoost's ability to detect minority sentiment is enhanced by SMOTE, while Logistic Regression remains more stable but struggles with negative sentiment classification. Wordcloud visualizations further illustrate key sentiment drivers, such as “bangun IKN” in positive sentiment and “pajak” in negative sentiment.

articleTitle: Personalised Travel Ratings using AI and Enhancing User Experience Through Multi-Dimensional Analytics
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The rapid advancements in Artificial Intelligence (AI) have enabled the development of intelligent systems for personalized travel recommendations. This study proposes a novel framework, Generative Adversarial Networks with Real-Time Analytics for Travel Experience (GAN-RATE), designed to enhance user satisfaction by integrating synthetic data generation and real-time feedback mechanisms. The GAN component addresses the challenge of sparsely rated travel attributes by generating high-quality synthetic data, while the Real- Time Analytics module evaluates user interactions and feedback to refine the recommendation process dynamically. The proposed framework considers multiple dimensions, including comfort, cleanliness, timeliness, entertainment amenities, and customer feedback, ensuring a holistic approach to travel rating prediction. Simulation analysis is conducted to compare the performance of GAN-RATE with existing algorithms. Metrics such as accuracy, mean absolute error (MAE), precision, recall, and computational efficiency are employed to evaluate system performance. Results indicate that GAN-RATE outperforms baseline models in prediction accuracy and adaptability to sparse datasets while demonstrating superior real-time response capabilities. The findings highlight the potential of GAN-RATE in improving user experience through personalized, data-driven recommendations, setting a new benchmark for AI-based travel recommendation systems.

articleTitle: RIDI-Hypothesis: A Foundational Theory for Cybersecurity Risk Assessment in Cyber-Physical Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This paper introduces the RIDI-Hypothesis, a theoretical framework designed to address cybersecurity vulnerabilities within Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS). By examining the functional block that generates nonces, we identify potential weaknesses such as replace, insert, delete, and inject, which can compromise nonce freshness. We extend our analysis to broader security considerations, proposing two hypotheses: System Security Design, which defines a system by a unique specification, and System Insecurity Design, where non-unique designs quantitatively represent insecurity. Our methodology utilizes UML diagrams to construct ABF-graphs, representing system specifications as logical structures. Using the Z3 SMT solver, we identify all potential insecure configurations. We also introduce an open-source cybersecurity risk assessment tool that quantifies risks and suggests mitigations. A case study involving a water level reader sensor demonstrates our approach, highlighting 16,777,216 potential scenarios of specification divergence. Our findings underscore the importance of precise design processes in mitigating cybersecurity risks. Future work will focus on verification and test-case generation to further enhance system security.

articleTitle: Brinjal Leaf Diseases Detection Based on Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Brinjal leaf diseases, such as leaf spot, mosaic virus, and wilt, would critically reduce crop yield quality if the disease is spread during an early stage. Such reasons have made early identification imperative to ensure effective prevention and management. This article, therefore, aims at coming up with an effective technique of identifying brinjal leaf diseases using VGG16 CNN model. Traditional identification methods are based on manually examining plant diseases, an effort known to be highly labour-consuming, subjective, and even unreliable. In addition, most of the available machine learning methods fail in scalability, computational cost, and specific domain problems. However, our technique makes use of the high ability of VGG16 architecture to extract automatically relevant features from leaf images and then classify them with high accuracy. Used Eggplant Leaf Disease Dataset which contains six classes. The central idea of our approach is to employ deep convolutional layers of VGG16 to extract discriminative features from the images followed by classification using fully connected layers and softmax activation. The approach obtains 98.2% accuracy for determining of Brinjalleaf diseases. This work will impact the agricultural sector by means of providing a fast automated solution that gives accurate insights about early detection of leaf disease occurrence, hence reducing losses to crops and enhancing production.

articleTitle: Effective Minimization of Fraud Using a Hybrid Novel Approach on Social Media
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: In a social context, optimizing information retrieval and user engagement is paramount. The challenges identified are the large volume of data, ensuring accuracy, and performance requires evolutionary structures. A novel approach is needed that combines machine learning algorithms with evolutionary optimization techniques to automatically recommend and refine tags on known segments of social media content. This safeguards against user attention diversion and potential risks to personal information. Activities encompass automated form feedback solicitation, user-reported content negativity flagged with custom tags in red, precise identification and processing, and accuracy validation. The process initiates with an initial set of tags generated through natural language processing (NLP) techniques, subsequently honed using a genetic algorithm. This iterative process refines tag selection based on content relevance, markedly augmenting tagging precision. Concurrently, a machine learning model analyzes user behavior patterns and preferences, fine-tuning tag recommendations based on historical data. The hybrid approach surpasses conventional tagging systems, exhibiting adaptability and learning capabilities that dynamically adjust tag recommendations to mirror emerging trends and individual user interests. Additionally, integrated user feedback mechanisms fine-tune the hybrid optimization model, enabling continuous enhancement and customization. Presently, web platform owners prioritize user engagement by eliminating misleading content segments. As the volume of social media content burgeons, this approach offers a scalable and effective solution to elevate content discoverability and relevance in the digital landscape.

articleTitle: ImageGuard: Advanced User Authentication via Dynamic Graphical Password Manipulation and Secured Image Sequences
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: User authentication is a critical aspect of cybersecurity, traditionally relying on alphanumeric passwords. However, these passwords are prone to various attacks, including brute force, dictionary, and shoulder-surfing attacks. As a result, there has been a shift towards more secure and user-friendly authentication methods. This study evaluates a secured image sequence-based user authentication system utilizing graphical password manipulation. By leveraging the human brain's superior ability to recognize and remember images over text, this system offers enhanced security against traditional password vulnerabilities such as brute force or dictionary attacks. The methodology involves click-based and choice-based graphical techniques, ensuring robust and user-friendly authentication. The proposed system demonstrates significant improvements in password security and usability, achieving a success rate of 92% with high user satisfaction.

articleTitle: Streamlining Financial Predictions: A Web Application for Stock, Cryptocurrency, and Market Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Among the high-degree lines of study in this area, one of the most interesting ones is stock price prediction, particularly in the context of machine learning and time series forecasting models. The traditional past ones include ARIMA, and SARIMAX, while deep learning models have been recently applied for predicting the stock prices based upon historical data. However, these models do hold much promise and also come with volatility and non-linearity in financial markets. Causes for such inaccuracies in predictions include sudden market shifts, external economic events, and investor sentiment. All these factors are difficult to model well. This study will propose a web application that uses advanced time series models to try and overcome such challenges. The system is implemented with Streamlit and Flask, so it gives users a smooth interface. It has five critical modules: Nifty 50, which deals with the analysis and forecasting of stocks using ARIMA and SARIMAX models; Global Market Data, which fetches real-time data from the Yahoo Finance API for granular analysis; Cryptocurrency, which relies heavily on Ethereum data with historical analysis and price forecasting; Twitter Sentiment Analysis, which focusses on real-time analysis of market sentiment through tweets; and the prediction module, which evaluates the accuracy of the models using Root Mean Square Error to measure prediction quality. This solution will provide a straightforward yet potent platform for analyzing stocks, cryptocurrency, and sentiment in real-time. The goal is to raise precision, reliability, and overall user experience concerning financial prediction, while more valuable insights become available to the investor and the researcher, having multiple sources integrated into the model.

articleTitle: Integrating Machine Learning and Statistical Models in Enterprise Risk Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Companies in the complex financial world face several risks that require careful investigation and management. This critical review assesses various frameworks for large-scale financial risk analysis in organizations. Globalization, technological advancements, regulatory changes, and financial market interconnectedness pose significant challenges to traditional risk management methods. This report identifies and analyzes key frameworks, including quantitative models, qualitative assessments, scenario analysis, stress testing, and Monte Carlo simulations, evaluating their adaptability and usefulness across different organizational settings based on industry categorization, scale, complexity, and regulatory framework. This study highlights the strengths and weaknesses of each framework, with a particular focus on their applicability to market, credit, liquidity, operational, and strategic risks. Furthermore, it examines the incorporation of emerging risk factors such as climate change, geopolitical instability, cyber risks, and socio-economic developments into these frameworks. Advanced methodologies, including machine learning algorithms, artificial intelligence, and big data analytics, have shown potential in enhancing the precision and reliability of risk analysis, enabling firms to detect, quantify, and mitigate large-scale hazards effectively. The impact of regulatory frameworks such as Basel III, Solvency II, Dodd-Frank Act, and IFRS on financial risk analysis is also discussed, emphasizing the need for alignment with evolving compliance requirements. The results demonstrate the superiority of advanced models, such as Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, which achieved the highest accuracy (94%) and F1 Score (0.91), showcasing their effectiveness in handling sequential and temporal data. Random Forest models also performed robustly, with an accuracy of 92% and an F1 Score of 0.90, highlighting their capability for feature importance ranking. The Support Vector Machine (SVM) with an RBF kernel achieved high precision (92%), reflecting its reliability in minimizing false positives. These findings underscore the effectiveness of combining advanced methodologies with traditional frameworks to tackle dynamic financial risks. In conclusion, this extensive examination illuminates the dynamic character of company-level financial risk analysis. By adopting flexible, adaptable, and scalable approaches, organizations can enhance their ability to manage risks, safeguard financial health, and seize opportunities in an increasingly unpredictable and interconnected global economy.

articleTitle: Augmenting Human Decision-Making: Exploring AI-Driven Automation in IT Operations (AIOps) for Enhanced Efficiency and Innovation
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This article analyzes how artificial intelligence (AI) has changed the IT industry, ushering in an age of unmatched technical growth and new potential for human-AI communication. Through a detailed research, it explores the complex dynamics of AI integration in IT operations, examining the likelihood that AI may supplant people in the workforce and highlighting the complexities and challenges that accompany this paradigm change. By examining present AI technologies, such as machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, and data science, and emphasizing both the benefits and imminent obstacles, this article discusses the complex environment of AI adoption in IT. It also digs thoroughly into the legal frameworks, social repercussions, and ethical challenges that must be overcome in order to govern the AI-driven revolution of the IT industry. Through this research, the article wants to peacefully cohabit human knowledge with AI talents, opening up new paths for creativity, productivity, and sustainable development in the digital age.
